Figure

Figure in dark

12kn 1422kn 1326 18kn

Figure in light

Sizes: sm 13, md 19 (the default), lg 48, the reading

12kn 14kn 18kn

The gust raised over the mean

1120 1422kn 1422kn

Alarm: a gust well over the mean, in the warm red

1221 1326kn

Other units: m, €, %

6.5m 1.7m €450 88%

A number first and large, in Inter's tabular figures (ui/Figure.tsx, figureStyles), its unit small after it and, where there is one, a second figure raised after it the way the site writes a gust over the mean (14 g22 is 14²²).

Anatomy

  • Root: .wf-figure, an inline row on the baseline, sem.space.x0-5 apart, Inter with tabular figures, never wrapping, in sem.color.ink.
  • Value: .wf-figure__value, the number.
  • Sup: .wf-figure__sup, the raised figure, set to the top of the row, at sem.font.size.caption and sem.font.weight.medium, in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Unit: .wf-figure__unit, kn, m, €, %, at sem.font.size.caption in sem.color.ink-muted.

Variants

  • --sm: the value at sem.font.size.body, semibold: a row's small figure.
  • md (the default): the figure step (sem.font.size.figure, its line, weight and tracking): the number a row is about.
  • --lg: the reading, sem.font.size.reading, semibold: the wind speed, one a view.
  • --alarm: the raised figure is the one to watch (a gust well over the mean): semibold, in sem.color.pen-ink.

States

  • None; it is not interactive.

Usage

  • Say it as a figure, not a sentence: 14 g22, 6 m.
  • One big figure a card (see [Card](../card/component.md)); --lg once a view.
  • --alarm is a gust, not emphasis.

Accessibility

  • Where the digits alone do not say what the figure is, give the root role="img" and an aria-label ("14 knots gusting 22").
  • The alarm is heavier as well as red, so it survives greyscale; its red is 5.7:1 on the light ground and 7.8:1 on the dark.
components/figure/component.css
/* Figure — ui/Figure.tsx (figureStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The number first and large in Inter's tabular figures, its unit small after
 * it and, where there is one, a second figure raised after it the way the
 * site writes a gust over the mean (14 g22 -> 14²²). The product's recipe
 * names the figures' face `font-mono`, which is Inter. */

.wf-figure {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

/* ---- the value, by size (md, the figure step, is the default) ---- */
.wf-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-figure);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-figure);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-figure);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-figure);
}
.wf-figure--sm .wf-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}
/* The reading: one a view, the wind speed. */
.wf-figure--lg .wf-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-reading);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-reading);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}

/* ---- the raised figure: the gust over the mean ---- */
.wf-figure__sup {
  align-self: flex-start;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}
/* The one to watch: a gust well over the mean, in the warm red and heavier. */
.wf-figure--alarm .wf-figure__sup {
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
}

/* ---- the unit: kn, m, €, % ---- */
.wf-figure__unit {
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}

Heading in light

How the stars work

We rate every daylight hour out of five stars, from four numbers.

Section

The week

All spots on the chart

A heading (ui/Heading.tsx, headingStyles), in Inter and sentence case, kept apart from what follows by space and never by a rule. It replaces the old headline, section heading and kicker.

Anatomy

  • Row: .wf-heading, the title with an optional aside on the same line, wrapping on a narrow screen.
  • Title: .wf-heading__title, an <h1>, <h2> or <h3>, Inter semibold in sem.color.ink, balanced across its lines.
  • Aside (optional): .wf-heading__aside, at the right of the title's line, a link, a count or an action, in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Lead (optional, page step): .wf-heading__lead, the line under a page's heading, sem.font.size.prose in sem.color.ink-2, no wider than sem.container.form.

Variants

  • Page (--page): the page's own <h1>, 40px in the product (the nearest token here is sem.font.size.headline), sem.font.size.title on a phone, tracked tight; with a lead line under it.
  • Section (.wf-heading, the default): an <h2> at sem.font.size.lead (19px), with a link or a count on the right ("All spots on the chart", "21 places").
  • Card (--card): an <h3> at sem.font.size.prose, for a card's own title.

States

  • None.

Usage

  • Sentence case, always: "How the stars work", "The week". Never capitals, never tracked letters, never an eyebrow over the heading.
  • No rule under a heading, and no frame round it: space separates it from what follows (sem.space.x3 to sem.space.x4 under a section heading).
  • Inter for every heading. The only Fraunces on the site is the [Wordmark](../wordmark/component.md) and a spot's name as the title of its own page; that title is the spot page's, not this component's.
  • The aside says something useful about the section: where to see all of it, how many there are. Not a second heading.

Accessibility

  • One <h1> a page; headings in order. Where the step's tag is wrong for the page's outline, the product sets as (h2 styled as a card heading, say).
  • The aside is outside the heading element, so it is not read as part of the title.
  • Contrast: titles 18.8:1 (light) and 17.5:1 (dark); the lead 11.3:1 and 11.9:1.
components/heading/component.css
/* Heading — ui/Heading.tsx (headingStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-*
 * only.
 *
 * Headings in Inter and sentence case, kept apart from what follows by space
 * and never by a rule. Three steps: a page's (40px, 32 on a phone, with a lead
 * line under it), a section's (19px, with a link or a count on the right) and
 * a card's (15px). Fraunces is the wordmark's and a spot's name's, and no
 * heading's. */

.wf-heading {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x3);
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
}

.wf-heading__title {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* Set right on the heading's line: a link, a count, an action. */
.wf-heading__aside {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}

/* The line under a page's heading. */
.wf-heading__lead {
  flex-basis: 100%;
  max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ---- page: the page's own heading ---- */
.wf-heading--page {
  align-items: flex-end;
  row-gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
}
.wf-heading--page .wf-heading__title {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-headline);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-title);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-headline);
}
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  /* sem.breakpoint.wide */
  .wf-heading--page .wf-heading__title {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-title);
    letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-title);
  }
}

/* ---- card: a card's own heading ---- */
.wf-heading--card .wf-heading__title {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

Hour cell

Hour cell in dark

Mon5 Tue6
16 17Mon 17:00 18 19 20 07 08 09
Stars
Windkn 13g21 12g20 11g18 10g17 8g15 8g14 8g14 7g14
From WSW WSW WSW WSW WSW N N N

Hour cell in light

Eight hours of the dock: past, now and selected, dark, a new day

Mon5 Tue6
16 17Mon 17:00 18 19 20 07 08 09
Stars
Windkn 13g21 12g20 11g18 10g17 8g15 8g14 8g14 7g14
From WSW WSW WSW WSW WSW N N N
Wingm² 6 6.5 7 7.5 8 8

One hour's column of the dock's table: the hour, its stars, the wind, where it comes from against the beach, and the wing to take. Drawn by the forecast dock (src/ForecastDock.tsx, and the phone's DockDay); no ui/ primitive yet.

Anatomy

  • Dock: .wf-hour-cell__dock, the strip that scrolls sideways (no visible scrollbar), a region with a label and tabindex="0" so a keyboard can scroll it; its focus ring is drawn inside. Room above the hours for the present hour's flag.
  • Table: .wf-hour-cell__table, a real <table>, collapsed, fixed layout, Inter with tabular figures. A <colgroup> sets the row-label column (__col-label, 88px) and one <col> per hour: 46px on a phone, 56px from sem.breakpoint.wide.
  • Row labels: .wf-hour-cell__label, a <th scope="row"> in a small grey label (sem.font.size.label, sem.color.ink-muted, sentence case) that stays put while the hours scroll; a unit beside it, __unit ("kn", "m²").
  • Rows, each .wf-hour-cell__row with a modifier: - --day: the day's head, "Mon 5" (the day semibold, the date grey). - --hour: the hour, "17", small and grey; these cells are <th scope="col">. - --stars: __stars, the hour's five places drawn with the site's star path as ui/StarGlyphs draws it: __star solid, __star--faded an outline at sem.opacity.faded (what the wind alone gives), __star--dot at sem.opacity.dot for each not reached. - --wind: .wf-wind-figure--cell, "14 g22". - --from: __from, the downwind arrow (12px), the compass point, and the shore-wind glyph (.wf-shore-compass--wind --sm). - --wing: the wing in m², in sem.color.ink-2.
  • Cell: .wf-hour-cell, centred, 28px tall (the day and hour rows 24).
  • No rules between rows: the dock is a floating card, and space separates.

Variants

  • None: one column is one hour. Its state is a set of classes repeated on every cell of the column.

States

  • Selected (--sel): the column on sem.color.sunken; the hour's own label filled in sem.color.inverse as a small pill with sem.color.ink-inverse figures, like a chosen chip, and aria-current="time" on it.
  • Night (--night): faintly shaded (sem.color.hatch), no stars and no wing. The wind is still shown.
  • Past (--past): the column at sem.opacity.past.
  • First hour of a day (--day-start): a hairline of sem.color.line on its left, through the day's head and every row.
  • Now (--now): a hairline of sem.color.pen down the middle of the column, with __flag over the hour: "Mon 17:00", a small pill of sem.color.pen-ink with sem.color.ink-inverse words.
  • Hover: a cell not selected goes to sem.color.sunken.

Usage

  • Load components/wind-figure/component.css and components/shore-compass/component.css beside this one.
  • The dock's day runs 07 to 20; a dark hour is never left blank and never rated.
  • The present-hour line and its flag are the strip's only red, but for the shore glyph's offshore arrow.
  • Keep the row labels to a word and a unit, in sentence case: Stars, Wind kn, From, Wing m².

Accessibility

  • A real table: hours are column headers (<th scope="col">), the row labels row headers (<th scope="row">), so a screen reader announces "17, Wind, 12 knots gusting 20".
  • The stars carry role="img" with "3 of 5 stars, 4 on the wind alone"; a dark hour has no stars to read, and its hour is still announced.
  • The selected hour is aria-current="time". The flag is aria-hidden: the time it shows is already the column's header and the day's head.
  • The flag's words on its red: 5.7:1 (light) and 7.8:1 (dark). The selected hour differs by fill, not colour alone.
  • The strip scrolls with the arrow keys once focused; the focus ring is drawn inside its edge.
components/hour-cell/component.css
/* Hour cell — one hour's column of the dock's table (the forecast dock,
 * src/ForecastDock.tsx; the phone's mobile/src/features/dock/DockDay.tsx).
 * No ui/ primitive yet. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The table is a real <table>: a row of hours (column headers), then Stars,
 * Wind kn, From and Wing m², each headed by a small grey label in sentence
 * case. No rules between the rows: space and the soft card the dock sits in
 * do the separating. An hour is the column of cells that share its state
 * classes:
 *   --sel        the selected hour: the column on the soft grey, its hour
 *                filled in ink like a chosen chip.
 *   --night      a dark hour: faintly shaded, its hour grey, no stars.
 *   --past       gone: the column at the past opacity.
 *   --day-start  the first hour of a day: a hairline on its left.
 *   --now        the present hour: a thin line of the warm red down the
 *                column, and a small flag at its head (`__flag`).
 *
 * The wind and its gust are `.wf-wind-figure--cell`, the shore glyph is
 * `.wf-shore-compass--wind`; load those components' CSS beside this one.
 * The star is drawn statically with the site's star path, as ui/StarGlyphs
 * draws it: solid, faded (the wind alone), a dot for each it does not reach. */

/* The strip scrolls sideways under the fixed row labels. */
.wf-hour-cell__dock {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  /* Room above the hours for the present hour's flag. */
  padding-top: var(--sem-space-x5);
}
.wf-hour-cell__dock::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}
.wf-hour-cell__dock:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
}

.wf-hour-cell__table {
  /* An hour's width: 46 on a phone, 56 from sem.breakpoint.wide. */
  --wf-hour-cell-w: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 11.5);
  width: max-content;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  /* sem.breakpoint.wide */
  .wf-hour-cell__table {
    --wf-hour-cell-w: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 14);
  }
}
.wf-hour-cell__table col {
  width: var(--wf-hour-cell-w);
}
.wf-hour-cell__table col.wf-hour-cell__col-label {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 22);
}

/* ---- the row labels: small, grey, sentence case, a unit beside ---- */
.wf-hour-cell__label {
  position: sticky;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x2) 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.wf-hour-cell__unit {
  margin-left: var(--sem-space-x1);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}

/* ---- a cell ---- */
.wf-hour-cell {
  position: relative;
  height: var(--sem-space-x7);
  padding: 0;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* The day's head: its name semibold, the date beside it in grey. */
.wf-hour-cell__row--day .wf-hour-cell {
  height: var(--sem-space-x6);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: default;
}
.wf-hour-cell__day {
  position: sticky;
  left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 22);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
}
.wf-hour-cell__day b {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* The hour: small and grey. */
.wf-hour-cell__row--hour .wf-hour-cell {
  height: var(--sem-space-x6);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
.wf-hour-cell__row--wing .wf-hour-cell {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
}

/* ---- the stars, as ui/StarGlyphs draws them ---- */
.wf-hour-cell__stars {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
  overflow: visible;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  /* sem.breakpoint.wide: a phone's narrower hour holds the five smaller. */
  .wf-hour-cell__stars {
    width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 10);
    height: auto;
  }
}
.wf-hour-cell__star {
  fill: currentColor;
}
.wf-hour-cell__star--faded {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-faded);
}
.wf-hour-cell__star--dot {
  fill: currentColor;
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-dot);
}

/* ---- From: the downwind arrow, the point, the shore glyph ---- */
.wf-hour-cell__from {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.wf-hour-cell__from .wf-wind-figure__arrow {
  width: var(--sem-space-x3);
  height: var(--sem-space-x3);
}
.wf-hour-cell__from .wf-wind-figure__point {
  margin: 0 var(--sem-space-x0-5) 0 0;
}

/* ---- states of the column ---- */
.wf-hour-cell--day-start {
  border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
}
.wf-hour-cell--night {
  background: var(--sem-color-hatch);
}
.wf-hour-cell--past {
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-past);
}
.wf-hour-cell--sel {
  background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
}
/* The selected hour's own label: filled in ink, like a chosen chip. */
.wf-hour-cell__row--hour .wf-hour-cell--sel {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}
.wf-hour-cell__row--hour .wf-hour-cell--sel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 2px var(--sem-space-x1);
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-inverse);
}
.wf-hour-cell__row--hour .wf-hour-cell--sel {
  isolation: isolate;
}
.wf-hour-cell:not(.wf-hour-cell--sel):hover {
  background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
}

/* The present hour: a thin line of the warm red down the middle of the
 * column. */
.wf-hour-cell--now::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 3;
  border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-pen);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.wf-hour-cell__row--hour .wf-hour-cell--now::after {
  top: auto;
  height: 0;
}
/* The flag: the time now, a small pill in the warm red over the hour. */
.wf-hour-cell__flag {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 100%;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 3;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
}
components/hour-cell/component.html (demo)
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Hour cell — wingfoil</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="component.css" />
    <style>
      /* Demo scaffolding only: the ground, a grey label over each row, soft cards. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .demo {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .demo__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .demo__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .demo__stack {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
      }
      .demo__card {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        /* A soft card: a control inside takes the second grey (on-card). */
        --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
      }
      /* Demo only: the dock is a floating card. */
      .demo__dock {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-float), 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-line);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>

            </tr>

              <th class="wf-hour-cell__label" scope="row">From</th>

Link

Link in dark

In running text, underlined

Best today from 13:00 to 16:00 on a 6 m. Low tide at 13:25, 1.7 m; the tide table has the week.

Hover (held)

Cross-shore at Rusheen Bay until the squall.

Focus-visible (held)

Four stars at Keel Beach, 14 knots gusting 22.

Plain: a list of nothing but links

Dollymount Brandon Bay The Burrow Donabate

Link in light

Low tide at 13:25, 1.7 m; the tide table has the week, and Rusheen Bay the best of it.

Dollymount Donabate

A link in text (ui/Link.tsx, linkStyles): a plain <a href> in the ink colour, underlined in running text, the accent under the pointer.

Anatomy

  • Link: .wf-link on an <a href>, in the surrounding face and size, in sem.color.quiet, with sem.radius.control so the focus ring takes a control's corner.
  • Underline (the default): a sem.rule.hairline line in sem.color.line-strong, 3px under the words.

Variants

  • Underlined (the default): in running text, where colour alone does not say "link".
  • Plain (--plain): no underline, for a list of nothing but links: a footer, a menu, a row of spot names.

States

  • Hover: the words go to sem.color.chart-magenta, and the underline with them (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus: :focus-visible draws the one ring, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus, sem.ring.offset clear (.is-focus).
  • Visited: no look of its own.

Usage

  • Underlined wherever a link sits among other words; plain only where every item is a link.
  • The words say where it goes ("tide table", "Rusheen Bay"), never "here".
  • A way back or on that sits with buttons is a Button --link, not this.
  • In the product a section's router takes the link over with its own click handler; it still opens in a new tab when asked to.

Accessibility

  • A real <a href>: announced as a link, followed with Enter, openable in a new tab.
  • The underline means a link in text is not said by colour alone; a plain link relies on its place in a list of links.
  • Contrast: the words 18.8:1 (light) and 17.5:1 (dark); under the pointer 6.6:1 and 6.8:1.
components/link/component.css
/* Link — ui/Link.tsx (linkStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * A link in text. In running text it is underlined, because ink alone does
 * not say "link": a hairline in the stroke grey under the ink, and both go
 * to the accent under the pointer. In a list of nothing but links
 * (a footer, a menu) it can go plain.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog; the product
 * reaches the same rules through :hover and :focus-visible. */

.wf-link {
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  color: var(--sem-color-quiet);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
  text-decoration-color: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
  /* underline-offset-3 is Tailwind's 3px, not a spacing step; no token holds
   * an underline offset (recorded as a gap). */
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}

.wf-link:hover,
.wf-link.is-hover {
  color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
  text-decoration-color: currentColor;
}

/* The one ring: 2px of the accent, 2px clear (RING). */
.wf-link:focus-visible,
.wf-link.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}

/* ---- plain: in a list of nothing but links, no underline ---- */
.wf-link--plain {
  text-decoration: none;
}

Notice marks

Water Orange warning Water advice

Something the reader should know (ui/Notice.tsx, Notice and NoticeMark): a weather warning, a bathing-water notice, something that went wrong. A quiet card with a coloured square and its sign, a plain title that says the level in words, a second line, and a chevron that opens the details. The notice mark, the same square small with a word beside it, is documented here too, because it carries the same levels.

Anatomy

  • Card: .wf-notice, sem.color.sunken carrying on-card, sem.radius.surface, 14px by sem.space.x4 inside; a three-column grid (sem.grid.notice): the square, the words, the end.
  • Square: .wf-notice__mark, 36px with a box's corner, the level's colour with its sign (__icon, 18px, stroke 1.75): an info sign, a warning triangle, or a drop for water. aria-hidden.
  • Title: .wf-notice__title, Inter semibold at sem.font.size.prose, saying the level in words: "Orange wind warning for Kerry", "Bathing is prohibited".
  • Second line: .wf-notice__meta, when, and what it does to the stars, in sem.color.ink-2.
  • End: .wf-notice__end, either the chevron (a quiet small icon [Button](../button/component.md) with __chevron) or an action in its place ("Try again").
  • Details (optional): .wf-notice__details, what the chevron opens, under the words.
  • Notice mark: .wf-notice-mark, the square (__square, 16px with sem.radius.mark; 28px with --md) and a word beside it (sem.font.size.body, medium). Used where a notice takes the place of the stars: an hour in the table, the Your stars card.

Variants

Levels (--<level> on the notice, the same on the mark):

  • info: an info sign in sem.color.ink-2 on sem.color.raised.
  • warn: a warning triangle in sem.color.pen-ink on sem.color.warn-ground. Something went wrong.
  • yellow, orange, red: Met Éireann's warning colours (sem.color.met-yellow, -orange, -red), the same on either ground; the sign near-black on yellow, white on orange and red.
  • water: a drop in sem.color.pen-ink on sem.color.warn-ground. Bathing is prohibited.
  • water-advice: a drop in sem.color.depth on sem.color.raised. Advice against bathing.

The notice mark comes in sm (the default) and md (--md).

States

  • Details closed and open: the chevron button carries aria-expanded and turns over when open; the details are hidden when closed.
  • Reduced motion: the chevron turns without the animation.

Usage

  • The title says the level in words, in sentence case. Never a capital chip ("ORANGE"), never a coloured bar down the side, never a frame.
  • One notice a subject. Several warnings stack, sem.space.x2 apart, the most severe first.
  • An action replaces the chevron only for something the reader can fix there: "Try again" when the forecast could not load.
  • Where a notice takes the place of the stars, show a notice mark with a word ("Water", "Orange warning"), not the full notice.

Accessibility

  • A warning that was there when the page came is plain content. Something that went wrong just now is role="alert" (the product's alert), so a screen reader is interrupted.
  • The level is in the title's words; the colour and sign are aria-hidden decoration.
  • The chevron is a button named "Details" (the product's detailsLabel renames it where a page has several: "Details of the orange warning"), with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the details.
  • Contrast: title 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark); second line 10.4:1 and 10.8:1. The signs: near-black on yellow 12.1:1, white on red 5.9:1, white on orange 3.1:1 (a sign, above the 3:1 a graphic needs).
components/notice/component.css
/* Notice and notice mark — ui/Notice.tsx (noticeStyles, noticeMarkStyles),
 * rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only, but for the signs on Met Éireann's
 * colours (see below).
 *
 * Something the reader should know, in a quiet card: a coloured square with
 * its sign, a plain title that says the level in words ("Orange wind
 * warning"), a second line, and a chevron that opens the details. No capital
 * chip, no coloured bar down the side. Met Éireann's yellow, orange and red
 * keep their own colours on either ground; bathing water is a drop on the
 * warm red's tint.
 *
 * The notice mark is the same square, small, with a word beside it, where a
 * notice takes the place of the stars. */

.wf-notice {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--sem-grid-notice);
  align-items: start;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5) 14px;
  padding: 14px var(--sem-space-x4);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
  background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  /* on-card: a control inside takes the second grey. */
  --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
}

/* The coloured square with its sign. */
.wf-notice__mark {
  display: grid;
  grid-row: span 2;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
}
.wf-notice__icon {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-x4) + var(--sem-space-x0-5));
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-x4) + var(--sem-space-x0-5));
}

.wf-notice__title {
  min-width: 0;
  padding-top: 1px;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}
.wf-notice__meta {
  grid-column-start: 2;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
}
/* The chevron, or an action in its place. */
.wf-notice__end {
  grid-column-start: 3;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  align-self: center;
}
.wf-notice__details {
  grid-column: 2 / span 2;
  min-width: 0;
  margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
}
.wf-notice__details[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
.wf-notice__chevron {
  transition: transform var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
[aria-expanded="true"] > .wf-notice__chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wf-notice__chevron {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ---- levels: the square's colour and its sign ---- */
.wf-notice--info .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--info .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-raised);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
}
.wf-notice--warn .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice--water .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--warn .wf-notice-mark__square,
.wf-notice-mark--water .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
}
.wf-notice--water-advice .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--water-advice .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-raised);
  color: var(--sem-color-depth);
}
/* Met Éireann's colours mean the same on any ground, and so do their signs:
 * near-black on yellow, white on orange and red, as the product draws them
 * (its photo-shade and photo-line). No token here carries those two. */
.wf-notice--yellow .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--yellow .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-met-yellow);
  color: #06080a; /* ds-lint-allow: the sign on Met yellow is near-black on either ground; no token is */
}
.wf-notice--orange .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--orange .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-met-orange);
  color: #ffffff; /* ds-lint-allow: the sign on Met orange is white on either ground; no token is */
}
.wf-notice--red .wf-notice__mark,
.wf-notice-mark--red .wf-notice-mark__square {
  background: var(--sem-color-met-red);
  color: #ffffff; /* ds-lint-allow: the sign on Met red is white on either ground; no token is */
}

/* ---- the notice mark: the square, small, with a word beside it ---- */
.wf-notice-mark {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
.wf-notice-mark__square {
  display: grid;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-mark);
}
.wf-notice-mark__icon {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}
.wf-notice-mark--md {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
}
.wf-notice-mark--md .wf-notice-mark__square {
  width: var(--sem-space-x7);
  height: var(--sem-space-x7);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
}
.wf-notice-mark--md .wf-notice-mark__icon {
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}

Number field

Number field in dark

Weight 80kg Your weight helps us suggest the right wing size.

Hover on a step, focus on the value (held); at the bottom of the range

5m² 2m²

Number field in light

Weight 80kg

A number moved in steps (ui/NumberField.tsx, numberFieldStyles): minus, the value with its unit, plus, in a filled capsule.

Anatomy

  • Capsule: .wf-number-field, 44px tall (sem.size.touch), on sem.color.well, round-ended, sem.space.x1 in from each end.
  • Steps: .wf-number-field__step, two round 36px buttons (touch-sized on a coarse pointer) holding a minus and a plus (__icon, 18px, stroke 1.75).
  • Value: .wf-number-field__value, a role="spinbutton" that takes the focus: Inter at sem.font.size.lead, semibold, tracked a little tight (sem.font.tracking.figure), tabular figures, at least 70px wide; its unit __unit small in sem.color.ink-muted.

Variants

  • None. The steps' names and the unit are the page's ("Lighter", "Heavier"; kg).

States

  • Hover: a step goes to sem.color.line (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus: the one ring on a step or on the value (.is-focus).
  • At the end of the range: that step is disabled, in sem.color.ink-disabled.

Usage

  • For an exact number moved in small steps: a rider's weight, a wing's size. A value along a range where the feel matters is a [Slider](../slider/component.md).
  • Under a [Field](../field/component.md) label, with a hint if the number needs one.

Accessibility

  • The value is a spin button with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and an aria-label ("Weight"); the arrow keys step it, Home and End go to the ends. Give it aria-valuetext where the number alone is not it ("75 kilograms").
  • Each step is a button named for what it does (aria-label="Lighter"); the icons are aria-hidden.
  • Contrast: the value 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark) on the capsule.
components/number-field/component.css
/* Number field — ui/NumberField.tsx (numberFieldStyles), rendered in CSS.
 * Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * A number moved in steps: minus, the value with its unit, plus, in a filled
 * capsule. The value is a spin button, so the arrow keys step it too.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog. */

.wf-number-field {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
}

.wf-number-field__step {
  display: grid;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-number-field__step:not(:disabled):hover,
.wf-number-field__step.is-hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-line);
}
.wf-number-field__step:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-number-field__step {
    width: var(--sem-size-touch);
    height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  }
}

.wf-number-field__value {
  min-width: 70px;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-figure);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: center;
}
.wf-number-field__unit {
  margin-left: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.wf-number-field__step:not(:disabled):focus-visible,
.wf-number-field__step.is-focus,
.wf-number-field__value:focus-visible,
.wf-number-field__value.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}

.wf-number-field__icon {
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}

Pager

Pager in dark

A middle page

Page 2 of 7

The first page

Page 1 of 7

Pager in light

Page 7 of 7

Previous and next through a long list, with the page in view between them (ui/Pager.tsx, pagerStyles). Its buttons are the Button component's small outlined ones.

Anatomy

  • Container: .wf-pager, a nav labelled "Pages", a centred row sem.space.x3 apart, sem.space.x2 above.
  • Previous: .wf-button.wf-button--sm, a 16px left chevron before its words.
  • Status: .wf-pager__status, "Page 2 of 7" in Inter at sem.font.size.caption, tabular, sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Next: the same button, a 16px right chevron after its words.

Variants

  • None. One page or none to turn to draws nothing at all: an empty list is one page.

States

  • First page: Previous disabled. Last page: Next disabled.
  • Hover and focus: the outlined button's own (.is-hover and .is-focus in the demo).

Usage

  • Under a list of listings, threads or mentions, centred under its column.
  • Count pages from one.
  • No filled button here: the pager is never the view's one action.

Accessibility

  • A nav with aria-label="Pages"; the status carries aria-current="page".
  • The chevrons are aria-hidden; the words name the buttons.
  • Disabled ends are real disabled buttons, skipped by the tab order; on a coarse pointer each button is at least sem.size.touch tall.
  • Contrast: the status 5.2:1 (light) and 6.1:1 (dark).
components/pager/component.css
/* Pager — ui/Pager.tsx (pagerStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 * Its buttons are the Button component's classes (components/button/
 * component.css): small outlined buttons, disabled at either end.
 *
 * Previous and next, and the page in view between them. Nothing at all is
 * drawn when everything fits on one page. */

.wf-pager {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
  padding-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
}

/* "Page 2 of 7": small, grey, with tabular figures. */
.wf-pager__status {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

Rows

Rows in dark

Rows that open a page

  • DollymountDublin
  • Brandon BayKerry
  • RosslareWexford

Rows with a value, and one that is dim

  • Cross-offshoreBlows out at an angle. You drift away from the beach.1 star off
  • OffshoreBlows out to sea. We don't recommend going out in it.No stars

A setting with a switch

  • HARMONIE2.5 km, 2½ days
  • GFS25 km, 16 days

Rows in light

  • DollymountDublin
  • Brandon BayKerry
  • OffshoreBlows out to sea.No stars

A list of rows in one soft card, a hairline between them inside it (ui/Rows.tsx, Rows and Row): the stars' key, the spot index, the models, a setting with its value.

Anatomy

  • Card: .wf-rows, a <ul> (or a <div> for a plain group) on sem.color.sunken with sem.radius.surface, carrying on-card (a control inside, a switch's row or a tag, takes the card's second grey); a sem.rule.hairline of sem.color.line between rows and nowhere else.
  • Row: .wf-rows__row, at least 56px tall, sem.space.x4 in from the sides, 14px between its parts: - lead (optional): __lead, an icon, a mark or a picture, in sem.color.ink-2; - main: __main, the title __title (Inter semibold at sem.font.size.prose) and an optional grey line __detail (sem.font.size.body, sem.color.ink-2); - end (optional): __end, the value or an action, at the right; - chevron (optional): __chevron at the end, in sem.color.ink-muted, for a row that opens a page.

Variants

  • Plain row: a <div>, for information (a key, a value).
  • Action (--action): a row that is a link (<a href>) or a button, taking the whole row as its target.
  • Dim (--dim): not available; the title and detail in sem.color.ink-muted ("No stars: offshore").

States

  • Hover (action): sem.color.line under the pointer (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus (action): the one ring, drawn inside the row so the card's corner does not clip it (.is-focus).

Usage

  • One card holds the rows; the rows do not each get a card.
  • The title says what the row is (a spot, a model, a setting), the detail a short fact about it (a county, a resolution). Sentence case.
  • The end is for one value or one control: a [Switch](../switch/component.md), a figure, a [Tag](../tag/component.md), a small button.
  • Lists longer than a screen want a heading per group ([Heading](../heading/component.md), section step) and a card per group.

Accessibility

  • A <ul> of rows, each in an <li>, so a screen reader hears how many.
  • An action row is one link or one button; its name is its title and detail. A control in the end of a plain row is named by the row's title (aria-labelledby).
  • The chevron is aria-hidden.
  • Contrast: titles 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark); details 10.4:1 and 10.8:1; dim words 4.8:1 and 5.6:1.
components/rows/component.css
/* Rows — ui/Rows.tsx (rowsStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * A list of rows in one soft card, a hairline between them inside it: the
 * key, the spot index, the models, a setting with its value. The name in
 * Inter semibold, a grey line under it, and the value or action on the right.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog. */

.wf-rows {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
  background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
  list-style: none;
  /* on-card: a control inside takes the second grey. */
  --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
}
.wf-rows > * + * {
  border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
}

.wf-rows__row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 13px var(--sem-space-x4);
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  text-align: left;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* A row that goes somewhere or does something: a wash under the pointer. */
.wf-rows__row--action {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-rows__row--action:hover,
.wf-rows__row--action.is-hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-line);
}
.wf-rows__row--action:focus-visible,
.wf-rows__row--action.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
}

.wf-rows__lead {
  display: grid;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
}
.wf-rows__main {
  display: grid;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  min-width: 0;
}
.wf-rows__title {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}
.wf-rows__detail {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
}
.wf-rows__end {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
}
.wf-rows__chevron {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-x4) + var(--sem-space-x0-5));
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-x4) + var(--sem-space-x0-5));
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}

/* Not available: the words in grey. */
.wf-rows__row--dim .wf-rows__title,
.wf-rows__row--dim .wf-rows__detail {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}

Search field

Search field in dark

Empty

Focused (held), with a way to clear it

lg, busy

Search field in light

A field that searches (ui/SearchField.tsx, searchFieldStyles): a soft grey pill with the magnifier in it. No underline, no frame.

Anatomy

  • Pill: .wf-search-field, 40px tall (sem.size.control.md), 14px in from each end, round-ended, on sem.color.well, a transparent hairline edge.
  • Icon: .wf-search-field__icon, a 16px magnifier in sem.color.ink-muted, stroke 1.75, aria-hidden.
  • Input: .wf-search-field__input, a bare <input type="search">, Inter at sem.font.size.prose (sem.font.size.input on a touch screen), placeholder in sem.color.ink-muted. The browser's own clear button is taken off.
  • After the input (optional): a way to clear it, a quiet small icon [Button](../button/component.md), inside the same pill.

Variants

  • md (the default), 40px; lg (--lg), 44px, for a search that is a page's main control.

States

  • Focus: the ink edge, the pill onto sem.color.ground, and a soft ring of the accent (the focus colour at 20%) (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Busy (aria-busy="true"): results on their way; a progress cursor.
  • Coarse pointer: never shorter than sem.size.touch.

Usage

  • For filtering a list in place (a spot index, a marketplace). The top bar's search for a spot by name is the [Spot search](../spot-search/component.md), which adds a list of results.
  • The placeholder says what can be searched: "Search spots", "Search listings".

Accessibility

  • A search has no visible label, so it must carry an aria-label; the product's types refuse one without it.
  • A results count is announced in a polite live region near the field, not in the field.
  • Contrast: typed words 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark) on the pill; placeholder 4.8:1 and 5.6:1.
components/search-field/component.css
/* Search field — ui/SearchField.tsx (searchFieldStyles), rendered in CSS.
 * Consumes --sem-* only, but for the soft focus ring.
 *
 * A soft grey pill with the magnifier in it; the ink edge, the ground and a
 * soft ring of the accent when it holds the focus. No underline, no frame.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the focused look still for the catalog. */

.wf-search-field {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--sem-size-control-md);
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  transition-property: border-color, background-color, box-shadow;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-search-field:focus-within,
.wf-search-field.is-focus {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  /* ds-lint-allow: the kit's soft focus ring is the focus colour at 20%, which no token carries */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sem-color-focus) 20%, transparent);
}
.wf-search-field[aria-busy="true"] {
  cursor: progress;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-search-field {
    min-height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  }
}

.wf-search-field--lg {
  height: var(--sem-size-touch);
}

.wf-search-field__icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}

.wf-search-field__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  appearance: none;
}
.wf-search-field__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}
.wf-search-field__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
.wf-search-field__input::-webkit-search-cancel-button {
  appearance: none;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-search-field__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
  }
}

Segmented

Segmented in dark

md, the default

sm, model names in their own spelling

lg and full: a question with a few answers

Hover and focus (held)

On a soft card: the well takes the card's second grey

Segmented in light

One of a few short options, all in view (ui/Segmented.tsx, segmentedStyles): a grey well with the chosen option lifted out of it. Five options at most.

Anatomy

  • Well: .wf-segmented, a role="group" with an aria-label, on sem.color.well (the soft grey on the ground, the card's second grey sem.color.raised on a soft card), round-ended, 3px of padding round the options. It scrolls sideways with no scrollbar if it ever runs out of room.
  • Option: .wf-segmented__item, a <button> 30px tall, sem.space.x3 across, round-ended. Inter at sem.font.size.body, sem.font.weight.medium, in sem.color.ink-2.
  • Chosen: aria-pressed="true", lifted onto sem.color.ground with sem.shadow.control and in sem.color.ink. In dark, where the ground is darker than the well, it is a lighter grey (sem.color.line over the well) with no shadow.

Variants

  • Sizes: --sm (26px, sem.font.size.label) for a tool over the map or inside a dock; md (30px, the default); --lg (38px, sem.font.size.prose) for a question with a few answers, as in a wizard.
  • Full (--full): across the whole width it is given, each option an equal share.
  • An option may carry a small icon before its words.

States

  • Hover: the words go to sem.color.ink (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus: the one ring on the option, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus.
  • Disabled option: sem.color.ink-disabled, default cursor.

Usage

  • Exactly one option is on. For several that can be on at once, use chips.
  • Short words: Graph and Table; Knots, Beaufort, m/s; Best first, Nearest, A to Z. Model names keep their own spelling (HARMONIE, ICON-EU): they are names, not labels in capitals.
  • On a soft card the well takes the card's second grey (on-card), so it shows there too.
  • The parts of one page or dialog, each with its own panel, are [Tabs](../tabs/component.md), not a segmented control.

Accessibility

  • A group of toggle buttons, each with aria-pressed; the group is named for what is being chosen ("Units").
  • The chosen option differs by fill and lift as well as colour.
  • Contrast: unchosen words 10.4:1 (light) and 10.8:1 (dark) on the well; chosen 18.8:1 and 16.0:1.
components/segmented/component.css
/* Segmented — ui/Segmented.tsx (segmentedStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes
 * --sem-* only.
 *
 * One of a few short options, all in view (five at most): a grey well, the
 * chosen one lifted out of it onto the ground. Model names keep their own
 * spelling (HARMONIE, ICON-EU): they are names, not labels set in capitals.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog. */

.wf-segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 3px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.wf-segmented::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.wf-segmented__item {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  transition-property: color, background-color, box-shadow;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-segmented__item:not(:disabled):hover,
.wf-segmented__item.is-hover {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

/* The chosen one: lifted onto the ground, in the ink colour. */
.wf-segmented__item[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-control);
}
/* In dark the ground is darker than the well, so the chosen one is a lighter
 * grey instead, with no shadow: the line colour over the well. */
[data-mode="dark"] .wf-segmented__item[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--sem-color-line);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.wf-segmented__item:not(:disabled):focus-visible,
.wf-segmented__item.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}
.wf-segmented__item:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
}

/* ---- sizes ---- */
.wf-segmented--sm .wf-segmented__item {
  height: 26px;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
}
.wf-segmented--lg .wf-segmented__item {
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
}

/* ---- full: across the whole width, each option an equal share ---- */
.wf-segmented--full {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
}
.wf-segmented--full .wf-segmented__item {
  flex: 1 1 0;
}

Select

Select in dark

Select in light

A native select in the kit's filled box (ui/Select.tsx, on ui/control.ts): the platform's own picker, the soft grey, a chevron at the right.

Anatomy

  • Box: .wf-select, at least 44px tall (sem.size.touch), 14px in from each side, sem.radius.control, on sem.color.well, a transparent hairline edge that the states colour.
  • Select: .wf-select__input, the bare native <select> with its own arrow taken off, Inter at sem.font.size.prose (sem.font.size.input on a touch screen), room on the right for the chevron.
  • Chevron: .wf-select__chevron, a 16px chevron in sem.color.ink-muted, aria-hidden.

Variants

  • Active (--active): an ink edge, for a filter narrowing the results ("County: Dublin" rather than "Any county").

States

  • Focus: the ink edge and a soft ring of the accent round the box (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Invalid: aria-invalid="true", or inside an invalid Field: the warm edge and ground.
  • Disabled: words in sem.color.ink-disabled, the box at 60%.

Usage

  • Inside a [Field](../field/component.md) with a visible label.
  • For a choice from many (a county, a model, a sort order with more than five answers). Up to five short answers that fit on one line read better as a [Segmented](../segmented/component.md) control.
  • The first option says what nothing chosen means: "Any county".

Accessibility

  • A native <select>: the platform's picker, keys and screen reader support.
  • Named by the Field's <label for>; the chevron is decoration.
  • Contrast: the chosen words 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark) on the grey.
components/select/component.css
/* Select — ui/Select.tsx on the kit's control box (ui/control.ts), rendered
 * in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only, but for the soft focus ring.
 *
 * A native select, the platform's own picker, in the filled box: the soft
 * grey, no rule round it, a chevron at the right; the ink edge and a soft ring
 * of the accent when it holds the focus.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the focused look still for the catalog. */

.wf-select {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  transition-property: border-color, background-color, box-shadow;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-select:focus-within,
.wf-select.is-focus {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  /* ds-lint-allow: the kit's soft focus ring is the focus colour at 20%, which no token carries */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sem-color-focus) 20%, transparent);
}

.wf-select__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  align-self: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x6) 0 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  cursor: pointer;
  appearance: none;
}
.wf-select__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-select__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
  }
}

.wf-select__chevron {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--sem-space-x3);
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* A filter that is narrowing the results: an ink edge, not colour alone. */
.wf-select--active {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

.wf-select:has([aria-invalid="true"]),
.wf-field--invalid .wf-select {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-warn);
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
}

.wf-select:has(:disabled) {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.wf-select:has(:disabled) .wf-select__input {
  cursor: default;
}

Shore compass

Shore compass in dark

Shore compass in light

Which way the beach faces: sm 16, md 18, lg 20

Facing

The wind against a beach facing WSW: five relations

Shore wind: sm 14 (dock), md 16 (popup), lg 18 (spot page)

In place: the popup's head, the spot page's line

Dublin
SE 123°DublinWSW 15 g26cross-offshore

Which way the beach faces, and how the wind meets it: the two shore glyphs the forecast draws (src/glyphs.tsx, src/chartGlyphs.tsx); no ui/ primitive yet.

Anatomy

  • Compass: .wf-shore-compass, an SVG on viewBox -10 -10 20 20.
  • __disc: r 8.8, sem.color.card ringed in ink at 0.9.
  • __north: a short ink tick at the top (M0 -8.8V-6.4), so the reader knows which way is up.
  • __face: a group turned by rotate(var(--facing)), holding __sea (a wedge in sem.color.depth pointing out to sea) and __beach (a heavy ink line, 1.7, round caps, across the wedge's foot). --facing is set inline: style="--facing: 247deg".
  • Shore wind: .wf-shore-compass--wind, an SVG on viewBox -9 -9 18 18.
  • __land: the beach below, a band in sem.color.land, with __hatch (fine diagonals in sem.color.line-strong) over it and __shore, an ink line along its top.
  • __wind holding __arrow: the downwind arrow a little above the beach, turned by rotate(calc(var(--from) - var(--facing) + 180deg)), so it is drawn as the wind meets this beach, not as north-up. Set both angles inline: style="--facing: 247deg; --from: 22deg".

Variants

  • Compass sizes: --sm 16 (the popup's head), md 18 (default), --lg 20 (the dock's head).
  • Shore-wind sizes: --sm 14 (a dock cell), md 16 (the popup), --lg 18 (the spot page).
  • Shore relation, on the shore-wind glyph: --onshore, --cross-on, --cross, --cross-off, --offshore. The relation is the angle between the wind and the facing: under 30° onshore, under 70° cross-on, under 110° cross, under 150° cross-off, else offshore.
  • --offshore and --cross-off draw the arrow in sem.color.pen, the warm red: the wind takes you out, not in.

States

  • None. Both are read-only glyphs; they draw what they are given.

Usage

  • The compass sits beside a spot's name or county (the popup's meta line, the dock's head, the spot page's line "SE 123°"). It describes the beach and never changes with the hour.
  • The shore-wind glyph sits beside a wind reading (the dock's "From" row, the popup's wind line, the spot page's "Shore" column) and changes with the hour.
  • Write the shore word beside it where there is room ("cross-offshore"); the red is a mark, not the message.
  • Red for offshore and cross-off only, never to decorate an onshore arrow.

Accessibility

  • Both glyphs carry role="img", an aria-label and a <title> for the pointer: "Beach faces WSW, 247°"; the shore wind's words, "onshore", "cross-onshore", "cross-shore", "cross-offshore", "offshore".
  • Inside a figure that already says the relation in its own label (the popup's wind line), the glyph's label is not read twice: the parent's role="img" makes it presentational.
  • The arrow's red is never the only signal: the relation is in the label and, where the layout allows, in words beside it.
components/shore-compass/component.css
/* Shore compass — the two shore glyphs the forecast draws (src/glyphs.tsx,
 * src/chartGlyphs.tsx), in CSS. No ui/ primitive yet. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * Two glyphs of one idea, which way the beach faces:
 *   .wf-shore-compass        a disc on the ground ringed in ink, a north tick, and,
 *                            turned by the facing, the sea (a depth wedge)
 *                            and the beach (a heavy ink line). viewBox -10 -10 20 20.
 *   .wf-shore-compass--wind  the wind against that beach: the beach below (a
 *                            land band, hatched, under an ink line) and an
 *                            arrow blowing downwind over it, in the warm red when the
 *                            wind is offshore or cross-off. viewBox -9 -9 18 18.
 *
 * The angles are inline custom properties, not colours:
 *   style="--facing: 247deg"                 the way the beach faces
 *   style="--facing: 247deg; --from: 22deg"  and where the wind comes from
 * Stroke widths are the drawing's geometry, in viewBox units. */

.wf-shore-compass {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.wf-shore-compass--sm {
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}
.wf-shore-compass--lg {
  width: var(--sem-space-x5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x5);
}

/* ---- the compass: which way the beach faces ---- */
.wf-shore-compass__disc {
  fill: var(--sem-color-card);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 0.9;
}
.wf-shore-compass__north {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.3;
}
/* The sea and the beach turn together, by the facing. */
.wf-shore-compass__face {
  transform: rotate(var(--facing, 0deg));
}
.wf-shore-compass__sea {
  fill: var(--sem-color-depth);
}
.wf-shore-compass__beach {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

/* ---- the wind against the beach: 16 by default (the popup), 14 in the dock, 18 on the spot page ---- */
.wf-shore-compass--wind {
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}
.wf-shore-compass--wind.wf-shore-compass--sm {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.5);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.5);
}
.wf-shore-compass--wind.wf-shore-compass--lg {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
}
.wf-shore-compass__land {
  fill: var(--sem-color-land);
}
.wf-shore-compass__hatch {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
  stroke-width: 0.6;
}
.wf-shore-compass__shore {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.1;
}
/* The arrow sits a little above the beach and points downwind, relative to it. */
.wf-shore-compass__wind {
  transform: translate(0, -2.2px) rotate(calc(var(--from, 0deg) - var(--facing, 0deg) + 180deg));
}
.wf-shore-compass__arrow {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
/* Off the beach is in the warm red: it takes you out, not in. The words say it too. */
.wf-shore-compass--offshore .wf-shore-compass__arrow,
.wf-shore-compass--cross-off .wf-shore-compass__arrow {
  stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
}

Skeleton

Skeleton in dark

Line, square as a line of type is

Block, a photo or a chart

A row loading in a soft card; the holder is aria-busy

Skeleton in light

The shape of what is loading, so the page does not jump when it lands (ui/Skeleton.tsx, skeletonStyles). It says nothing itself.

Anatomy

  • Shape: .wf-skeleton, a block-level span filled with sem.color.line (the hairline's colour, which shows on the ground and on a soft card alike), breathing with sem.animate.pulse. The caller sets its width.

Variants

  • Line (.wf-skeleton, the default): sem.space.x3 tall, the field's sem.radius.control.
  • Block (--block): at least 128px (32 steps) tall, a box's corner (sem.radius.surface): a photo, a chart, a card's worth.
  • Circle (--circle): sem.size.control.md across, a full circle: an avatar.

States

  • Loading: pulses from 0.45 opacity to whole and back, a second each way.
  • Reduced motion: still (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce); the shape alone says something is coming.

Usage

  • Draw the shape of what will land: as many lines as the row has, at roughly their widths, inside the same box.
  • Swap the whole holder at once when the data lands; do not mix skeletons and real rows.
  • Never as decoration, and never coloured: it is the hairline's colour only.

Accessibility

  • Each shape is aria-hidden. The element that holds them carries aria-busy="true" (and a label where it has none), and drops it when the content lands.
  • Motion is held for a reader who asks for less.
components/skeleton/component.css
/* Skeleton — ui/Skeleton.tsx (skeletonStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The shape of what is loading, so the page does not jump when it lands. Drawn
 * in the hairline's colour, which shows on the ground and on a soft card
 * alike, breathing gently; still for a reader who asks for less motion. It
 * says nothing itself: whatever holds it carries aria-busy. */

/* shape="line" (the default): square, as a line of type is. */
.wf-skeleton {
  display: block;
  height: var(--sem-space-x3);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-line);
  animation: var(--sem-animate-pulse);
}

/* shape="block": a photo, a chart, a card's worth (128px at the least). */
.wf-skeleton--block {
  height: auto;
  min-height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 32);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
}

/* shape="circle": an avatar, a control. */
.wf-skeleton--circle {
  width: var(--sem-size-control-md);
  height: var(--sem-size-control-md);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wf-skeleton {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* As ui/theme.css draws it: from just under half, back to whole, alternating. */
@keyframes pulse {
  from {
    opacity: 0.45;
  }
}

Slider

Slider in dark

25kn
Hours over it get fewer stars.

Focus (held)

70km

Slider in light

25kn

A value along a range (ui/Slider.tsx, sliderStyles, drawn by the theme's range-kit): a thin track filled in the ink colour up to a round white thumb, and the value said beside it with its unit.

Anatomy

  • Row: .wf-slider, the track then the value, 14px apart.
  • Track: .wf-slider__input, a native <input type="range">, 28px tall for the pointer, the visible track 4px (sem.space.x1) and round-ended: filled in sem.color.ink up to the thumb, sem.color.line-strong after it. The page sets --wf-slider-fill (the product's --range-fill) to the value's share of the range.
  • Thumb: a 22px white circle with a faint edge and a soft shadow, white on either ground.
  • Value: .wf-slider__value, Inter at sem.font.size.prose, semibold, with tabular figures, at least 54px wide so the track does not move as it changes; its unit __unit small in sem.color.ink-muted.

Variants

  • None. The value can be written as the page likes ("25", "1.2"), with or without a unit.

States

  • Focus: the one ring round the track, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Disabled: the platform's own.

Usage

  • For a value where the feel of the range matters more than the exact number: the wind you like, how far you will drive. An exact number moved in small steps (a weight) is a [Number field](../number-field/component.md).
  • Under a [Field](../field/component.md) label, which says what it is.

Accessibility

  • A native range input: the arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End work, and a screen reader hears the value in its range.
  • The value beside the track is aria-hidden; set aria-valuetext on the input where the number alone does not say it ("25 knots").
  • Name it with the Field's <label for> or an aria-label.
components/slider/component.css
/* Slider — ui/Slider.tsx (sliderStyles) and the theme's range-kit, rendered
 * in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only, but for the thumb (see below).
 *
 * A value along a range: a thin track filled in the ink colour up to a round
 * white thumb, and the value said beside it with its unit. A native range
 * input, so the keys, a screen reader and a thumb work as the platform's.
 * `--wf-slider-fill` (a percentage) is set on the input by the page, as the
 * product sets `--range-fill`. */

.wf-slider {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
}

.wf-slider__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--sem-space-x7);
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}
.wf-slider__input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: var(--sem-space-x1);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    var(--sem-color-ink) var(--wf-slider-fill, 0%),
    var(--sem-color-line-strong) var(--wf-slider-fill, 0%)
  );
}
.wf-slider__input::-moz-range-track {
  height: var(--sem-space-x1);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
}
.wf-slider__input::-moz-range-progress {
  height: var(--sem-space-x1);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-ink);
}
/* The thumb is white on either ground, as the product draws it; no token is
 * white in both modes, so its fill and edge are literals. */
.wf-slider__input::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  margin-top: -9px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: #ffffff; /* ds-lint-allow: the thumb is white on either ground; no token is white in both modes */
  /* ds-lint-allow: the thumb's hairline and shadow are the product's literals (range-kit in ui/theme.css) */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00000014, 0 1px 3px #0000004d;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}
.wf-slider__input::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: #ffffff; /* ds-lint-allow: the thumb is white on either ground; no token is white in both modes */
  /* ds-lint-allow: the thumb's hairline and shadow are the product's literals (range-kit in ui/theme.css) */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00000014, 0 1px 3px #0000004d;
}
.wf-slider__input:focus-visible,
.wf-slider__input.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
}

/* The value beside the track, with its unit. */
.wf-slider__value {
  min-width: 54px;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
}
.wf-slider__unit {
  margin-left: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
