A spot on the chart, drawn as the chart's light: a ring with the hour's stars in it and an arrow blowing downwind, the spot's name beside it with the wind under it. Drawn by the map (src/map.css, .lt, and the phone's map lights); no ui/ primitive yet.

Anatomy

  • Target: .wf-spot-light, a <button> 20px round (sem.space.x5), with no fill or border of its own. On a coarse pointer an invisible sem.size.touch disc grows the target; the glyph stays the same size.
  • Glyph: .wf-spot-light__glyph, an SVG drawn at 60px round the target (viewBox -30 -30 60 60), and inside it: - __wind holding __arrow, stroked in the ink colour at 1.7, turned by rotate(calc(var(--from) + 180deg)) so it points where the wind blows to. --from is set inline (style="--from: 247deg"). - __ring: r 7.6, sem.color.card ringed in the ink colour at 1.1. - __n: the hour's star count, Inter semibold at sem.font.size.caption, tabular. - __strike: a line of sem.color.pen through the ring, shown only when offshore.
  • Label: .wf-spot-light__label, beside the target, on a halo of sem.color.ground (a soft text-shadow). __name is Inter semibold at sem.font.size.body; __line is the wind under it at sem.font.size.caption, medium, in sem.color.ink-muted: "4★ WSW 14".

Variants

  • --s0: a dashed ring in sem.color.ink-disabled, the figure grey at medium weight. Nothing to ride.
  • --s1, --s2: the open ring (the default).
  • --s3, --s4: filled in sem.color.inverse, the figure in sem.color.ink-inverse.
  • --s5: filled in the accent (sem.color.chart-magenta): the best, the one place on the chart that colour says it.
  • --dark: not rated. The ring faintly shaded (sem.color.hatch) and ringed in sem.color.ink-disabled, no figure, the arrow faint; the line starless ("WSW 13").
  • --off: offshore. Struck through in sem.color.pen, the ring and arrow in the same red, the figure and the line in sem.color.pen-ink, and the line ends "· offshore". Struck, red and worded: never colour alone. Combine with the star class (--s2 --off).
  • --xoff: cross-offshore. The arrow in the warm red, the line grey, ending "· cross-off".
  • --named: the label shown (a featured spot, or the chart zoomed in far enough to name every light).

States

  • Selected (--sel, with aria-pressed="true"): the label is shown and the light rises a size over its neighbours.
  • In focus: a container with .wf-spot-light-field--focus dims every light but the selected one to sem.opacity.dot and hides their labels, so the spot in view stands alone.
  • Hover and focus: the glyph scales 1.18 (sem.duration.fast); held still in the demo with .is-hover and .is-focus. Reduced motion drops the transition.
  • Focus-visible: the one ring, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus, with sem.space.x1-5 clear, so it rounds the glyph rather than the 20px target.

Usage

  • One per spot on the map, positioned by the map at the spot's centre.
  • The ring's fill says the stars and nothing else. Do not tint a light by wind speed.
  • The accent only at five stars. Do not use --s5 to mean "selected": the selected light is --sel, which keeps its stars' fill.
  • Names in Inter, never in the serif and never italic.
  • The line is figures: stars, compass point, knots, and the shore word only when the wind is off the beach.

Accessibility

  • A real <button type="button">; the glyph and the visual label are aria-hidden, and the button carries the whole reading in its aria-label: "Rusheen Bay: 4 stars, WSW 14 knots", "Brandon Bay: 2 stars, ENE 12 knots, offshore", "Keel Beach: dark, WSW 13 knots".
  • The selected light exposes aria-pressed="true".
  • Offshore is said three ways: the strike, the red and the word.
  • The label's halo keeps the words readable over sea and land; the grey line is 5.2:1 (light) and 6.1:1 (dark) on the ground.
  • Touch: the coarse-pointer target is sem.size.touch across.
components/spot-light/component.css
/* Spot light — the spot's light on the chart (src/map.css `.lt`, and the
 * phone's map lights). No ui/ primitive yet. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * A 20px target, with the glyph drawn at 60px round it (viewBox -30 -30 60 60):
 * a ring with the hour's stars in it, an arrow blowing downwind, and beside it
 * the label (the name in Inter semibold, the wind under it in grey) on a halo
 * the colour of the ground.
 * Shape carries the kind; the ring's fill carries the stars, and nothing else.
 *
 * The wind is an inline custom property, not a colour: style="--from: 247deg"
 * (where it blows from); the arrow is turned to point where it blows to.
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog; the product
 * reaches the same rules through :hover and :focus-visible. */

.wf-spot-light {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: var(--sem-space-x5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x5);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

/* A finger gets a touch-sized target; the glyph does not grow. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-spot-light::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: var(--sem-size-touch);
    height: var(--sem-size-touch);
    border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  }
}

.wf-spot-light:focus-visible,
.wf-spot-light.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  /* The ring clears the glyph, not the 20px target. */
  outline-offset: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
}

/* ---- the glyph, 60px round the 20px target ---- */
.wf-spot-light__glyph {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--sem-space-x5) * -1);
  left: calc(var(--sem-space-x5) * -1);
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 15);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 15);
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition-property: transform, opacity;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast), var(--sem-duration-base);
}
.wf-spot-light:hover .wf-spot-light__glyph,
.wf-spot-light:focus-visible .wf-spot-light__glyph,
.wf-spot-light.is-hover .wf-spot-light__glyph,
.wf-spot-light.is-focus .wf-spot-light__glyph {
  transform: scale(1.18);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wf-spot-light__glyph {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* The arrow turns by where the wind blows to: from + 180°. */
.wf-spot-light__wind {
  transform: rotate(calc(var(--from, 0deg) + 180deg));
}
.wf-spot-light__arrow {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
.wf-spot-light__ring {
  fill: var(--sem-color-card);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1.1;
}
.wf-spot-light__n {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wf-spot-light__strike {
  display: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
  stroke-width: 1.6;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

/* ---- the label: the name, then the wind, on a halo of the ground ---- */
.wf-spot-light__label {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1);
  left: var(--sem-space-x5);
  display: none;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  /* The halo: the ground round the letters, so they read over sea and land. */
  text-shadow:
    0 0 2px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 3px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 5px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 8px var(--sem-color-ground);
}
.wf-spot-light__name {
  display: block;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}
.wf-spot-light__line {
  display: block;
  margin-top: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
/* Named: a featured spot, or the chart zoomed in far enough to name them all. */
.wf-spot-light--named .wf-spot-light__label,
.wf-spot-light--sel .wf-spot-light__label {
  display: block;
}

/* ---- the stars: the ring's fill says them ---- */
/* 0: a dashed ring, faint. */
.wf-spot-light--s0 .wf-spot-light__ring {
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
  stroke-dasharray: 2 1.6;
}
.wf-spot-light--s0 .wf-spot-light__n {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
/* 1 and 2: the open ring (the default). 3 and 4: filled in ink. */
.wf-spot-light--s3 .wf-spot-light__ring,
.wf-spot-light--s4 .wf-spot-light__ring {
  fill: var(--sem-color-inverse);
}
.wf-spot-light--s3 .wf-spot-light__n,
.wf-spot-light--s4 .wf-spot-light__n {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
}
/* 5: the best, in the accent. */
.wf-spot-light--s5 .wf-spot-light__ring {
  fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
}
.wf-spot-light--s5 .wf-spot-light__n {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
}

/* Dark: not rated. The ring shaded as the dark hours are, no figure. */
.wf-spot-light--dark .wf-spot-light__ring {
  fill: var(--sem-color-hatch);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
}
.wf-spot-light--dark .wf-spot-light__arrow {
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
}
.wf-spot-light--dark .wf-spot-light__n {
  display: none;
}

/* Offshore: struck through in the warm red, and said in words on the line. */
.wf-spot-light--off .wf-spot-light__ring {
  fill: var(--sem-color-card);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
  stroke-dasharray: none;
}
.wf-spot-light--off .wf-spot-light__n {
  fill: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
}
.wf-spot-light--off .wf-spot-light__strike {
  display: inline;
}
.wf-spot-light--off .wf-spot-light__arrow,
.wf-spot-light--xoff .wf-spot-light__arrow {
  stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
}
.wf-spot-light--off .wf-spot-light__line {
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
}
/* Cross-off: the arrow in the warm red, the line grey with "· cross-off". */

/* ---- selected, and the field round it ---- */
.wf-spot-light--sel {
  z-index: 2;
}
/* The selected light a size up where it stands (src/map.css .lt.sel). */
.wf-spot-light--sel .wf-spot-light__glyph {
  transform: scale(1.3);
}
/* A field in focus: the selected light stands, the others dim and lose their names. */
.wf-spot-light-field--focus .wf-spot-light:not(.wf-spot-light--sel) .wf-spot-light__glyph {
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-dot);
}
.wf-spot-light-field--focus .wf-spot-light:not(.wf-spot-light--sel) .wf-spot-light__label {
  display: none;
}
components/spot-light/component.html (demo)
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Spot light — wingfoil</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="component.css" />
    <style>
      /* Demo scaffolding only: the ground, a grey label over each row, soft cards. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .demo {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .demo__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .demo__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .demo__stack {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
      }
      .demo__card {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        /* A soft card: a control inside takes the second grey (on-card). */
        --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
      }
      /* Demo only: the chart's sea stand-in, a light in each slot, and a coast. */
      .demo__map {
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      .demo__key {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 10);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      .demo__chart {
        position: relative;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 55);
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      .demo__lights {
        gap: var(--sem-space-x5);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x5);
      }
      .demo__dot {
        display: inline-flex;
      }
      .demo__states {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x6);
      }
      .demo__slot {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x8);
      }
      .demo__coast {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .demo__coast path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-land);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
        stroke-width: 1;
      }
      .demo__chart .wf-spot-light {
        position: absolute;
        left: var(--x);
        top: var(--y);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="demo" data-mode="dark">

          <svg class="wf-spot-light__glyph" viewBox="-30 -30 60 60" aria-hidden="true"><g class="wf-spot-light__wind"><path class="wf-spot-light__arrow" d="M0 -9.6V-20.5M-3.4 -16.6L0 -21L3.4 -16.6" /></g><circle class="wf-spot-light__ring" r="7.6" /><line class="wf-spot-light__strike" x1="-5.6" y1="5.6" x2="5.6" y2="-5.6" /><text class="wf-spot-light__n" y="3.4" text-anchor="middle">0</text></svg>

      <p class="demo__label">Named: every state, with its wind line</p>

The top bar's search (ui/SpotSearch.tsx, spotSearchStyles): a field that finds a riding place as the rider types, with a list of results under it. With nothing typed it offers the rider's own spots and the ones they look at most.

Anatomy

  • Field: .wf-spot-search__field, a soft grey pill (sem.color.sunken), 40px tall and 320px wide; while in use it widens to 400px and comes onto sem.color.ground with an ink edge. Inside: the magnifier (__icon, 16px), the input (__input, Inter at sem.font.size.body, "Search spots"), and the "/" key (__key, a small hairline box) or, once something is typed, a quiet clear button.
  • Results: .wf-spot-search__panel, a sheet under the field on sem.color.ground with sem.shadow.sheet and a faint sem.color.line edge, sem.radius.surface, at most 480px tall and scrolling.
  • Group name: .wf-spot-search__group-name, a small grey label in sentence case: "Your spots", "You look at".
  • Option: .wf-spot-search__option, a row with a box's corner: the spot's name (__name, Inter semibold at sem.font.size.prose, the typed letters __mark underlined in the accent) and its county under it (__county), and on the right, where it is cheap, today's wind and stars (__detail).
  • None: .wf-spot-search__none, "Type a spot's name or its county." or what was not found.
  • Foot: .wf-spot-search__foot, what Enter does and what the right of a result shows, in small grey words. Not on a phone.

Variants

  • Computer: the field in the [Top bar](../top-bar/component.md) beside the wordmark.
  • Phone: the field folds into a round quiet icon button; pressed, it opens as a field the width of the screen over the bar (56px tall, a hairline under it, a Cancel button), with the results filling the screen under it.

States

  • Focus: the field widens and takes the ink edge (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Active option: aria-selected="true", on sem.color.sunken; the arrow keys and the pointer move it.
  • Reduced motion: the field changes width without the animation.

Usage

  • One spot search a page, in the top bar. Filtering a list in place is a [Search field](../search-field/component.md).
  • What a pick does is the page's: the finder and a spot's page go to the spot's page; the chart flies to the spot and opens it there.
  • About 150 places, filtered at once as the rider types: no wait, no spinner.

Accessibility

  • An ARIA combobox: the input has role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls (the list box) and aria-activedescendant (the active option); the results are a role="listbox" of role="option"s in role="group"s named by their group name.
  • The arrow keys move through the results, Enter picks, Escape clears and then closes, and "/" anywhere on the page that is not a field comes to it (not under an open dialog).
  • How many were found is said in a polite status region.
  • The phone's round button is named "Search spots" and carries aria-expanded.
  • Contrast: names 18.8:1 (light) and 17.5:1 (dark); counties 5.2:1 and 6.1:1.
components/spot-search/component.css
/* Spot search — ui/SpotSearch.tsx (spotSearchStyles), rendered in CSS.
 * Consumes --sem-* only. Its clear and phone buttons are the Button
 * component's (load its CSS beside this one).
 *
 * The top bar's search: a field that finds a riding place as the rider types,
 * an ARIA combobox with a list of results under it. The field is a soft grey
 * pill that widens a little and comes onto the ground, with an ink edge,
 * while it is in use. The results are a sheet under it: groups with a small
 * grey name, each spot its name in Inter semibold, its county under it, the
 * typed letters underlined in the accent.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the field's focused look still for the catalog. */

.wf-spot-search {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
}

.wf-spot-search__field {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 320px;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--sem-size-control-md);
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x2-5) 0 14px;
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  transition-property: width, border-color, background-color;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-spot-search__field:focus-within,
.wf-spot-search__field.is-focus {
  width: 400px;
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wf-spot-search__field {
    transition: none;
  }
}

.wf-spot-search__icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
}

.wf-spot-search__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  appearance: none;
}
.wf-spot-search__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}
.wf-spot-search__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-spot-search__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
  }
}

/* The "/" that brings the search from anywhere on the page. */
.wf-spot-search__key {
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-mark);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}

/* ---- the results: a sheet under the field ---- */
.wf-spot-search__panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: 48px;
  left: 0;
  z-index: var(--sem-z-index-dialog);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 380px;
  max-height: 480px;
  padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-sheet), 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-line);
}
/* A static rendering: the sheet in the flow, under its field. */
.wf-spot-search__panel--static {
  position: static;
  margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
}

.wf-spot-search__group-name {
  padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x2-5) var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}

.wf-spot-search__option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
  padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.wf-spot-search__option[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
}
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  .wf-spot-search__option {
    min-height: 52px;
  }
}

.wf-spot-search__words {
  display: grid;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  min-width: 0;
}
.wf-spot-search__name {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* The letters typed, found in the name. */
.wf-spot-search__mark {
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
  text-decoration-thickness: var(--sem-rule-heavy);
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.wf-spot-search__county {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* The right of a result, where it is cheap: today's wind and stars. */
.wf-spot-search__detail {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 3px;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}

.wf-spot-search__none {
  margin: 0;
  padding: var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
}
.wf-spot-search__foot {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
  padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x2-5) var(--sem-space-x1);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
}
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  .wf-spot-search__foot {
    display: none;
  }
}

StarGlyphs

StarGlyphs in dark

StarGlyphs in light

0 to 5: solid, faded (the wind alone), dots to five

The dark: an empty slot, not rated

Tones: ink, inverse on an ink fill, the accent (the best, once)

Slots: five (the default), potential (a narrow cell)

An hour's stars as the site draws them everywhere (ui/StarGlyphs.tsx, starGlyphsStyles): solid for what the hour is worth for this rider, an outline for what the wind alone would give, and a dot for each of the five it does not reach. The dark is not rated.

Anatomy

  • Root: .wf-star-glyphs, an inline SVG, overflow: visible, aligned to the middle, size px tall and count × size + (count − 1) × gap wide, where the gap is max(1, floor(size / 6)).
  • Solid: .wf-star-glyphs__solid, the site's five-point star (radius 5), translated to the slot's centre plus 0.4 down and scaled by size / 10.4, filled currentColor.
  • Faded: .wf-star-glyphs__faded, the same star, outlined in currentColor at 0.95 / scale, at sem.opacity.faded.
  • Dot: .wf-star-glyphs__dot, a circle of size × 0.07 at the slot's centre, filled currentColor at sem.opacity.dot.
  • Geometry lives in the SVG; paint lives in the CSS.

Variants

  • Tone: none (the text's own colour), --ink, --inverse (sem.color.ink-inverse, on an ink fill: a selected hour, a chosen chip), --magenta (sem.color.chart-magenta, the accent: the best of the week, once).
  • Slots: five (the default) or potential (stops at the last outline, for a cell too narrow for five; the dark still takes five).
  • Coloured (coloured, the spot finder's cards only for now): the earned stars filled in sem.color.stars.1 … sem.color.stars.5 by how many, with a faint edge, and the rest of the five outlined in the ink colour (fainter with none); no potential, no dots.
  • Size: 9.5, 10 (the dock), 12 (the default), 14.

States

  • Stars 0 to 5, with the potential at or above them.
  • The dark (null): an empty SVG of the same width, so a row of hours stays in line; its row is faintly shaded (sem.color.hatch), never rated.

Usage

  • Draw stars with this, never with an icon set's stars.
  • Shape carries the difference between solid and outline; tone only repeats it.
  • The accent for the one best, once a view.

Accessibility

  • role="img" with a label: "3 of 5 stars, 4 on the wind alone", or "Dark: not rated".
  • The outline at half opacity is a mark beside a solid one, never the only carrier of a figure; the label says it in words.
components/star-glyphs/component.css
/* StarGlyphs — ui/StarGlyphs.tsx (starGlyphsStyles), rendered in CSS.
 * Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * An hour's stars as the site draws them: solid for what the hour is worth
 * for this rider, an outline for what the wind alone would have given, and a
 * small dot for each of the five it does not reach. Shape carries the
 * difference; the tone only repeats it. The dark is not rated: an empty SVG of
 * the same width, so a row of hours stays in line.
 *
 * The geometry is the component's and lives in the SVG: the star path at
 * radius 5, scaled by size / 10.4 and set 0.4 below centre; a gap of
 * max(1, floor(size / 6)); an outline of 0.95 / scale; a dot of size * 0.07.
 * Only paint lives here, and it is currentColor. */

.wf-star-glyphs {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ---- tones: none, by default, is whatever the text round it is ---- */
.wf-star-glyphs--ink {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}
/* On an ink fill: a selected hour, a chosen chip. */
.wf-star-glyphs--inverse {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
}
/* The best of the week, where the accent marks it. */
.wf-star-glyphs--magenta {
  color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
}

/* ---- the three marks ---- */
.wf-star-glyphs__solid {
  fill: currentColor;
}
/* What the wind alone would give: an outline, faded. */
.wf-star-glyphs__faded {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-faded);
}
/* A place the hour does not reach. */
.wf-star-glyphs__dot {
  fill: currentColor;
  opacity: var(--sem-opacity-dot);
}
components/star-glyphs/component.html (demo)
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>StarGlyphs — wingfoil</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="component.css" />
    <style>
      /* Demo scaffolding only: the ground, a grey label over each row, soft cards. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .demo {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .demo__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .demo__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .demo__stack {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
      }
      .demo__card {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        /* A soft card: a control inside takes the second grey (on-card). */
        --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
      }
      .demo__map {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      .demo__caption {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .demo__stack {
        justify-items: start;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .demo__inverse {
        display: inline-flex;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x2);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-inverse);
      }
      /* A run of hours in a soft card, a hairline between them; the dark faintly shaded, unrated. */
      .demo__hours {
        display: grid;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: var(--sem-container-dialog);
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .demo__hour {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x4);
      }
      .demo__hour + .demo__hour {
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .demo__hour--dark {
        background: var(--sem-color-hatch);
      }
      .demo__ist {
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
    </style>
  </head>

Switch

Switch in dark

Off, on, focus (held), disabled

In a soft card, with its words

Wind in colour
Live windBuoys and stations, the latest reading

Switch in light

Wind in colour
Live windBuoys and stations, the latest reading

On or off, taking effect at once (ui/Switch.tsx, switchStyles): a flat track that fills with the ink colour when on, a round thumb sliding across.

Anatomy

  • Track: .wf-switch, a <button role="switch"> 44 by 26px, round-ended, on sem.color.line-strong; sem.color.inverse when on.
  • Thumb: .wf-switch__thumb, a 20px circle on sem.color.ground with sem.shadow.control, 3px in from the edge; it slides 18px when on.
  • Row (optional): .wf-switch-row, the words on the left (__words, a title and an optional __detail line in sem.color.ink-2) and the switch on the right, at least sem.size.touch tall.

Variants

  • None. One size.

States

  • Off and on (aria-checked); the thumb's position says which as well as the fill.
  • Focus: the one ring, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Disabled: the whole switch at 40%, the default cursor.
  • Reduced motion: the thumb jumps, it does not slide.
  • Coarse pointer: an invisible band makes the target touch-tall.

Usage

  • For a setting that takes effect the moment it is changed: Wind in colour, Live wind, Show tides. A choice that is only applied on Save is a [Checkbox](../checkbox/component.md).
  • Name it in the row's words, in sentence case; never "On" and "Off" beside it.
  • Rows of switches sit in one soft card, a hairline between them (see [Rows](../rows/component.md)).

Accessibility

  • role="switch" with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle it, as a button's do.
  • A switch has no words of its own: give it aria-label, or aria-labelledby pointing at the row's title.
  • Contrast: the on track against the ground is 18.8:1 (light) and 17.5:1 (dark); the off track 3.4:1 and 3.7:1, above the 3:1 a control's edge needs.
components/switch/component.css
/* Switch — ui/Switch.tsx (switchStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-*
 * only.
 *
 * On or off, taking effect at once: a flat track that fills with the ink
 * colour when on, the thumb sliding across. No gradient, no frame.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the ring still for the catalog. */

.wf-switch {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 44px;
  height: 26px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-switch[aria-checked="true"] {
  background: var(--sem-color-inverse);
}
.wf-switch:not(:disabled):focus-visible,
.wf-switch.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}
.wf-switch:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.4;
}
/* A thumb's reach on a touch screen: an invisible band to touch height. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-switch::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -9px 0;
  }
}

.wf-switch__thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  width: var(--sem-space-x5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x5);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-control);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-switch[aria-checked="true"] .wf-switch__thumb {
  transform: translateX(18px);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .wf-switch,
  .wf-switch__thumb {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* A switch in a row: its words on the left, the switch on the right. */
.wf-switch-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x4);
  min-height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}
.wf-switch-row__words {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
}
.wf-switch-row__detail {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
}

Tabs

Tabs in dark

Horizontal

Your weight, your wing sizes and the wind you like.

Vertical, down the side of a wide dialog

Knots, Beaufort or metres a second.

Tabs in light

The parts of one page or dialog (ui/Tabs.tsx, tabsStyles): a row of words, the current one on a soft pill. Down the side of a wide dialog, a column of the same.

Anatomy

  • List: .wf-tabs, a role="tablist" with an aria-label and aria-orientation; it scrolls sideways with no scrollbar when it runs out of room.
  • Tab: .wf-tabs__tab, a <button role="tab">, Inter at sem.font.size.prose, sem.font.weight.medium, in sem.color.ink-2, sem.space.x2 by sem.space.x3, round-ended.
  • Current: aria-selected="true", on sem.color.well in sem.color.ink.
  • Panel: the content each tab shows, a role="tabpanel" the tab points at with aria-controls.

Variants

  • Horizontal (the default): a row of words under a page's heading or a dialog's title.
  • Vertical (--vertical): a column down the side of a wide dialog (Settings), each tab the column's width with a box's corner (sem.radius.control).

States

  • Hover: sem.color.well under the pointer (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus: the one ring, sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus.
  • Current: the soft pill and the ink colour.

Usage

  • For the parts of one thing, each with its own panel: Settings' Riding, Units, Display; a spot index's counties.
  • One of a few values that changes what is shown in place (Graph or Table) is a [Segmented](../segmented/component.md) control, not tabs.
  • No rule under the row and no underline under the current tab: the pill says which one it is.

Accessibility

  • The tab list pattern: only the current tab is in the tab order (tabindex="0", the others -1); the arrow keys move between tabs (left and right, or up and down when vertical), Home and End go to the first and last, and Tab leaves the list.
  • The current tab differs by fill as well as colour.
  • Contrast: tab words 10.4:1 (light) and 10.8:1 (dark) on the ground.
components/tabs/component.css
/* Tabs — ui/Tabs.tsx (tabsStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The parts of one page or dialog: a row of words, the current one on a soft
 * pill. Down the side of a wide dialog, a column of the same.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog. */

.wf-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.wf-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.wf-tabs__tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition-property: color, background-color;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-tabs__tab:hover,
.wf-tabs__tab.is-hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
}
.wf-tabs__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}
.wf-tabs__tab:focus-visible,
.wf-tabs__tab.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}

/* ---- vertical: a column down the side of a wide dialog ---- */
.wf-tabs--vertical {
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  overflow: visible;
}
.wf-tabs--vertical .wf-tabs__tab {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 9px var(--sem-space-x3);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
}

Tag

Tag in dark

Neutral, off, ok

Unsure coming Offshore Flat water

Beside a name, on a soft card

Dollymount Offshore now

Glass, over a picture

Sentinel-2, 28 Oct

Tag in light

Unsure Offshore Flat water Sentinel-2, 28 Oct

A word on a thing that cannot be pressed (ui/Tag.tsx, tagStyles): a condition, a status, a category. Offshore, Unsure, now, coming. A choice the rider can press is a [Chip](../chip/component.md).

Anatomy

  • Tag: .wf-tag, a <span> 22px tall, sem.space.x2 across, round-ended.
  • Words: Inter at sem.font.size.label (12px), sem.font.weight.medium, in sentence case. An optional small icon before them.

Variants

  • Neutral (.wf-tag, the default): sem.color.ink-2 on sem.color.well (the card's second grey on a soft card).
  • Off (--off): sem.color.pen-ink on sem.color.warn-ground. Offshore, a warning, something wrong.
  • Ok (--ok): sem.color.ok on sem.color.well. Good to go.
  • Glass (--glass): sem.color.glass with sem.blur.glass, over a photograph; solid for a reader who has turned transparency down.

States

  • None. A tag does not hover, focus or press.

Usage

  • One or two words. Sentence case, never capitals, never tracked.
  • Beside a name or a figure, never as a heading or an eyebrow over one.
  • Do not make a tag look pressable, and do not put a link in one.
  • A tag is not a notice: a weather warning is a [Notice](../notice/component.md) or, where it replaces the stars, a notice mark.

Accessibility

  • Plain text in a <span>; it is read with what it sits beside. Give it words that make sense out of context ("Offshore wind", not just a colour).
  • Off is said in words as well as red.
  • Contrast: neutral 10.4:1 (light) and 10.8:1 (dark); off 4.8:1 and 6.1:1; ok 5.5:1 and 7.9:1.
components/tag/component.css
/* Tag — ui/Tag.tsx (tagStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * A word that describes something and cannot be pressed: Offshore, Unsure,
 * now, coming. A small capsule in sentence case, never in capitals. */

.wf-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-x5) + var(--sem-space-x0-5));
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Offshore, a warning, something wrong: the warm red on its tint. */
.wf-tag--off {
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
}

/* Something good: the green on the well. */
.wf-tag--ok {
  color: var(--sem-color-ok);
}

/* Over a photograph: a ground that lets a little through. */
.wf-tag--glass {
  background: var(--sem-color-glass);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--sem-blur-glass));
}
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  .wf-tag--glass {
    background: var(--sem-color-solid);
    backdrop-filter: none;
  }
}

Text area

Text area in dark

A few lines is plenty.
Say what you saw at the spot.

Text area in light

Several lines of writing (ui/TextArea.tsx, on ui/control.ts): the kit's filled box, taller.

Anatomy

  • Box: .wf-text-area, 14px in from each side, sem.radius.control, on sem.color.well, a transparent hairline edge that the states colour.
  • Text area: .wf-text-area__input, the bare <textarea>, 138px tall before anything is written (three large controls), sem.space.x3 above and below the words, Inter at sem.font.size.prose with sem.font.line.normal (sem.font.size.input on a touch screen). It grows downward only (resize: vertical).

Variants

  • None.

States

  • Focus: the ink edge and a soft ring of the accent round the box (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Invalid: aria-invalid="true", or inside an invalid Field: the warm edge and ground.
  • Disabled: words in sem.color.ink-disabled, the box at 60%.

Usage

  • Inside a [Field](../field/component.md) with a visible label; a hint says how long or what to cover ("What's included, its condition, where it can be collected").
  • For a listing's description, a report, a message. One line of text is a [Text input](../text-input/component.md).

Accessibility

  • Named by the Field's <label for>; hint and error tied with aria-describedby.
  • Contrast: written words 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark); placeholder 4.8:1 and 5.6:1.
components/text-area/component.css
/* Text area — ui/TextArea.tsx on the kit's control box (ui/control.ts),
 * rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only, but for the soft focus ring.
 *
 * The filled box, three large controls tall before anything is written,
 * growing downward as the writer drags it.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the focused look still for the catalog. */

.wf-text-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  transition-property: border-color, background-color, box-shadow;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-text-area:focus-within,
.wf-text-area.is-focus {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  /* ds-lint-allow: the kit's soft focus ring is the focus colour at 20%, which no token carries */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sem-color-focus) 20%, transparent);
}

.wf-text-area__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 138px;
  padding: var(--sem-space-x3) 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
  resize: vertical;
}
.wf-text-area__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}
.wf-text-area__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-text-area__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
  }
}

.wf-text-area:has([aria-invalid="true"]),
.wf-field--invalid .wf-text-area {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-warn);
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
}
.wf-text-area:has(:disabled) {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

Text input

Text input in dark

€
Focused (held). Buyers see it on the card.
Give an email address we can write to.

Text input in light

€
Give an email address we can write to.

A one-line text field (ui/TextInput.tsx, on the kit's control box in ui/control.ts): filled with the soft grey, no rule round it.

Anatomy

  • Box: .wf-text-input, at least 44px tall (sem.size.touch), 14px in from each side, a box's corner (sem.radius.control), on sem.color.well, with a transparent hairline edge that the states colour.
  • Input: .wf-text-input__input, the bare <input> filling the box, Inter at sem.font.size.prose; sem.font.size.input (16px) on a touch screen so a phone does not zoom. Placeholder in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Adornment (optional): .wf-text-input__adornment, a currency sign or a unit inside the box, in sem.color.ink-muted.

Variants

  • Active (--active): an ink edge, for a filter that is narrowing the results as opposed to sitting at "any".
  • With an adornment: "€" ahead of a price, "kg" after a weight.

States

  • Focus: the ink edge and a soft ring of the accent round the box (the focus colour at 20%); the bare input draws no ring of its own (.is-focus in the demo).
  • Invalid: aria-invalid="true" on the input, or inside an invalid [Field](../field/component.md): a sem.color.warn edge on sem.color.warn-ground.
  • Disabled: words in sem.color.ink-disabled, the box at 60%.

Usage

  • Always inside a Field with a visible label.
  • Placeholder text is an example, not the label: "e.g. Dollymount".
  • No underline-only fields, no frames: the grey fill says "write here".
  • The fill is sem.color.well: the soft grey on the ground, the card's second grey (sem.color.raised) inside a soft card, so a field shows on either.

Accessibility

  • The Field's label names the input; the hint and error are tied to it with aria-describedby.
  • Wrong is said in the Field's words as well as the warm edge and ground.
  • Contrast: typed words 17.3:1 (light) and 16.0:1 (dark); placeholder 4.8:1 and 5.6:1.
components/text-input/component.css
/* Text input — ui/TextInput.tsx on the kit's control box (ui/control.ts),
 * rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only, but for the soft focus ring.
 *
 * A filled field: the well's grey, no rule round it; the ink edge and a
 * soft ring of the accent when it holds the focus. The box is what is drawn:
 * it takes the edge, the hover and the ring, so a prefix sits inside the same
 * outline as the text.
 *
 * `.is-focus` holds the focused look still for the catalog. */

.wf-text-input {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-well);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  transition-property: border-color, background-color, box-shadow;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}
.wf-text-input:focus-within,
.wf-text-input.is-focus {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  /* ds-lint-allow: the kit's soft focus ring is the focus colour at 20%, which no token carries */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sem-color-focus) 20%, transparent);
}

.wf-text-input__input {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  align-self: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}
.wf-text-input__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}
.wf-text-input__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
/* A focused field under 16px makes a phone zoom the page. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-text-input__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
  }
}

/* A unit or a currency sign, inside the box ahead of the text. */
.wf-text-input__adornment {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
}

/* A filter that is narrowing the results: an ink edge, not colour alone. */
.wf-text-input--active {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

/* Wrong: the warm edge and ground, with the Field's words. */
.wf-text-input:has([aria-invalid="true"]),
.wf-field--invalid .wf-text-input {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-warn);
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
}

.wf-text-input:has(:disabled) {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

Tide label

Tide label in dark

Low tide 13:25, 1.7 m High tide 13:25, 4.2 m 4.1 m

Tide label in light

The turn, beside its mark

Low tide 13:25, 1.7 m High tide 13:25, 4.2 m

On the dock's tide row: 07:00 to 20:00, now 11:00, scrolls

The popup's line

4.1 m 2.5 m

A tide's turn, written beside its mark: "Low tide 13:25, 1.7 m". The forecast's tide row and its high and low water glyphs (src/chartGlyphs.tsx); no ui/ primitive yet.

Anatomy

  • Label: .wf-tide-label, an inline row: the turn's mark, then the words in Inter medium at sem.font.size.caption, tabular, on a halo of sem.color.ground (a soft text-shadow) so they read over the curve.
  • Mark: __mark holding __dot, r 2.6. High water is a filled dot (--high on the label, or __dot--high in SVG); low water an open dot ringed in the ink colour.
  • Curve: __curve, the dock's 40px tide row as SVG. __sea fills under the level in sem.color.sea; __level strokes it in sem.color.depth at 1.4; a __dot sits on each turn with __text beside it (below a high, above a low, anchored left unless it would run off the end); __now is a 3.4 dot in the accent (sem.color.chart-magenta) at the present hour. In SVG the halo is a stroke of the ground painted under the letters (paint-order: stroke).
  • Line: --line, the popup's tide: __wave (a 14 by 8 wave in sem.color.depth at 1.3) and "4.1 m" at sem.font.size.body.

Variants

  • --low and --high: which turn the label names.
  • --line: the popup's one line, no halo.

States

  • None. The curve's present-hour dot moves with the time the map is set to.

Usage

  • On the dock's tide row, one label per turn of the tide in the day's hours; on the spot page, the same marks on the day's curve, with the times and heights in a table in a soft card below.
  • The words are figures: "High tide 13:25, 4.2 m". No "approximately", no sentence.
  • The accent dot is the present hour on the curve, its one accent mark.
  • With no tide station near, say so in a plain grey line instead of drawing a flat curve.

Accessibility

  • The HTML label is text, read as written.
  • The curve carries role="img" and an aria-label listing its turns and the present height: "Tide: low 07:05 2.2 m, high 13:25 4.2 m, low 20:10 1.7 m; now 3.6 m".
  • The popup's line is role="img" with "Tide 4.1 m"; the wave is decoration.
  • High and low are told apart by shape (filled and open) and by the word, not by colour.
components/tide-label/component.css
/* Tide label — a tide's turn, written beside its mark on the curve (the
 * forecast's tide row and its HighTideGlyph and LowTideGlyph,
 * src/chartGlyphs.tsx). No ui/ primitive yet. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 *   .wf-tide-label           "Low tide 13:25, 1.7 m" as HTML: the turn's mark,
 *                            then the words in Inter medium at the caption
 *                            step, on a halo of the ground.
 *   .wf-tide-label__curve    the same on the dock's tide row, as SVG: the curve
 *                            in depth over a sea fill, a mark at each turn, the
 *                            words beside it, an accent dot at the present hour.
 *   .wf-tide-label--line     the popup's line: a small wave in depth, "4.1 m".
 *
 * A turn's mark: high water a filled dot, low water an open dot ringed in ink. */

.wf-tide-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  /* The halo: the ground round the letters, so they read over the curve. */
  text-shadow:
    0 0 2px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 3px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 4px var(--sem-color-ground);
}

/* ---- the turn's mark: r 2.6 on the curve ---- */
.wf-tide-label__mark {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  overflow: visible;
}
.wf-tide-label__dot {
  fill: var(--sem-color-card);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.wf-tide-label--high .wf-tide-label__dot,
.wf-tide-label__dot--high {
  fill: var(--sem-color-inverse);
}

/* ---- the curve, on the dock's tide row ---- */
.wf-tide-label__curve {
  display: block;
  overflow: visible;
}
.wf-tide-label__sea {
  fill: var(--sem-color-sea);
}
.wf-tide-label__level {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-depth);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
}
/* The words in SVG: the halo is a stroke of the ground painted under the fill. */
.wf-tide-label__text {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  paint-order: stroke;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ground);
  stroke-width: 3px;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
/* The present hour on the curve: the accent, once. */
.wf-tide-label__now {
  fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
}

/* ---- --line: the popup's tide, a wave and a figure ---- */
.wf-tide-label--line {
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  text-shadow: none;
}
.wf-tide-label__wave {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x2);
}
.wf-tide-label__wave-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-depth);
  stroke-width: 1.3;
}

wingfoil.ie
Chart

The one top bar, on every page that has a head (ui/TopBar.tsx, topBarStyles): the finder, the chart, a spot's page, How the stars work, the spot index, Use with AI.

Anatomy

  • Bar: .wf-top-bar, a <header> 64px tall (56 on a phone), on sem.color.ground, sem.space.x6 in from the sides, with one sem.rule.hairline of sem.color.line under it and nothing heavier.
  • Brand: .wf-top-bar__brand, a link home holding the [Wordmark](../wordmark/component.md), named "wingfoil.ie, the Spot finder".
  • Search: .wf-top-bar__search, the [Spot search](../spot-search/component.md), 18px after the wordmark.
  • Gap: .wf-top-bar__gap, which pushes the rest to the right.
  • Actions (optional): .wf-top-bar__actions, a section's own few actions (the marketplace's Sell, the community's bell).
  • View: .wf-top-bar__view, one outlined [Button](../button/component.md) with an icon to the other view: "Chart" (a map icon) from the finder and the pages, "Spots" (a list icon) on the chart.
  • Theme: .wf-top-bar__theme, a round outlined icon button showing what it switches to (the sun in dark, the moon in light).
  • Menu: .wf-top-bar__menu, the site menu's round button at the far right.

Variants

  • Computer (the default) and phone (under sem.breakpoint.wide, by the width): 56px tall, the search folded into a round button after the wordmark, the view button a little narrower, light or dark moved into the menu. --phone draws it at any width for a static rendering.

States

  • None of its own; its links and buttons carry theirs.

Usage

  • Every page with a head uses this bar and no other; no page draws its own masthead, nameplate or title band.
  • At most one outlined button for the other view and a few section actions. The bar holds no filled button: the page's one filled action is in the page.
  • No second rule, no shadow, no tint: the hairline is the bar's only edge.

Accessibility

  • A <header> landmark. The wordmark link is named for where it goes.
  • The view button carries a title ("The full chart", "The list of spots"); icon-only buttons (theme, menu, search on a phone) carry aria-label.
  • The search is reached by "/" from anywhere on the page that is not a field.
  • Every target is at least sem.size.touch on a coarse pointer.
components/top-bar/component.css
/* Top bar — ui/TopBar.tsx (topBarStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-*
 * only. Its buttons are the Button component's, its mark the Wordmark's and
 * its search the Spot search's (load their CSS beside this one).
 *
 * The one top bar, on every page that has a head: the wordmark at the left
 * (it goes home), the search beside it, then at the right a section's own
 * actions, one outlined button for the other view (Chart, or Spots on the
 * chart), light or dark, and the site menu at the far right. 64px tall, 56 on
 * a phone, with one hairline under it and nothing heavier. On a phone the
 * search folds into a round button and light or dark moves into the menu.
 * `--phone` draws the phone's bar at any width, for a static rendering. */

.wf-top-bar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--sem-z-index-header);
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: 64px;
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x6);
  border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
  background: var(--sem-color-ground);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
}

.wf-top-bar__brand {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.wf-top-bar__brand:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}

.wf-top-bar__search {
  min-width: 0;
  margin-left: 18px;
}
.wf-top-bar__gap {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.wf-top-bar__actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
}

/* ---- a phone: under sem.breakpoint.wide, or `--phone` ---- */
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  .wf-top-bar {
    height: 56px;
    gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
    padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
  }
  .wf-top-bar .wf-top-bar__search {
    order: 1;
    margin-left: 0;
  }
  .wf-top-bar .wf-top-bar__actions {
    order: 2;
    gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  }
  .wf-top-bar .wf-top-bar__view {
    order: 2;
    padding: 0 14px;
  }
  .wf-top-bar .wf-top-bar__theme {
    display: none;
  }
  .wf-top-bar .wf-top-bar__menu {
    order: 3;
  }
}
.wf-top-bar--phone {
  height: 56px;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-top-bar__search {
  order: 1;
  margin-left: 0;
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-top-bar__actions {
  order: 2;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-top-bar__view {
  order: 2;
  padding: 0 14px;
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-top-bar__theme {
  display: none;
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-top-bar__menu {
  order: 3;
}
.wf-top-bar--phone .wf-wordmark {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-wordmark-sm);
}

      /* Demo scaffolding only: the ground, a grey label over each row, soft cards. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .demo {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .demo__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .demo__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .demo__stack {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
      }
      .demo__card {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        /* A soft card: a control inside takes the second grey (on-card). */
        --sem-color-well: var(--sem-color-raised);
      }
      .demo__window {
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .demo__window--narrow {
        max-width: 390px;
      }
    </style>
  </head>

Wind figure

Wind figure in dark

1221WSW 1526WSW 14g22
13g26W·6.5 m

Wind figure in light

Row, a spot page: the mean, the gust raised, downwind

1221WSW 1119SW 1319N

Alarm: a big jump in the gust

1219N 1526WSW

Cell: the dock

14g22 13g21 8g15 14g22

Line: the popup

13g26W·6.5 m
13g19N·6.5 m
14g22WSW·6 m

The wind and its gust, as the site writes them: 12²¹ ↗ WSW on a spot page, 14 g22 in the dock, → 13 g26 W · 6.5 m in a popup. It is ui/Figure.tsx (value, sup, unit, alarm) with a downwind arrow and the compass point beside it.

Anatomy

  • Container: .wf-wind-figure, an inline row in Inter with tabular figures, on the baseline, sem.space.x0-5 apart.
  • __value: the mean knots, at the figure step (sem.font.size.figure, semibold, tracked a little tight).
  • __sup: the gust, raised, at sem.font.size.caption, medium, in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • __unit: a small word after a figure, sem.font.size.caption, grey.
  • __dir: the downwind arrow (__arrow, 16px, stroked in currentColor, turned by rotate(calc(var(--from) + 180deg))) and __point, the compass point at sem.font.size.label in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • __gust: the dock's and popup's "g22", written on the line, not raised.
  • __wing, __sep: the popup's wing figure and its "·".

Variants

  • Row (the default): a spot page's wind. 12 at the figure step, 21 raised, then the arrow and "WSW".
  • Alarm (--alarm): the gust is a big jump over the mean. The raised figure turns to sem.color.pen-ink and semibold: weight and colour together.
  • Cell (--cell): the dock's wind row. The knots at sem.font.size.body, semibold, then "g22" small and grey, sem.space.x1 apart.
  • Line (--line): a popup's wind line at sem.font.size.body: the arrow (13px), the knots semibold, "g26", the compass point, the shore-wind glyph (.wf-shore-compass--wind), "·", the wing semibold and "m", sem.space.x1-5 apart.
  • Inverse (--inverse): on an ink fill, every part in sem.color.ink-inverse.

States

  • None of its own. In the dock the cell takes the hour's state (past, selected, dark) from the [Hour cell](../hour-cell/component.md).

Usage

  • Write wind as figures: 14 g22, never a sentence.
  • The gust goes raised where a figure leads (a card, a row), and on the line ("g22") where space is tight or the line is read left to right.
  • Alarm only for a gust well over the mean, never for emphasis.
  • The arrow always points downwind (where the wind goes), as on the map.
  • The compass point is a name and keeps its letters (WSW); nothing else here is in capitals.
  • The --line form needs components/shore-compass/component.css loaded for its shore glyph.

Accessibility

  • The figure carries role="img" and an aria-label in words: "13 knots gusting 26 from the west"; the dock cell "14 knots gusting 22"; the popup line adds the shore and wing: "13 knots gusting 26 from the west, cross-offshore, 6.5 m wing".
  • The arrow is aria-hidden; the compass point is spelt out in the label ("west-south-west"), not read as letters.
  • Contrast: the grey gust 5.2:1 (light) and 6.1:1 (dark); the alarm 5.7:1 and 7.8:1.
components/wind-figure/component.css
/* Wind figure — the wind and its gust as the site writes them. No ui/ primitive
 * of its own: it is ui/Figure.tsx (figureStyles: value, sup, unit, alarm) with
 * a downwind arrow and the compass point beside it, in the three places the
 * site writes it:
 *
 *   row  (the default, a spot page's hour): 12²¹ ↗ WSW. The mean at the
 *        figure step, the gust raised small after it (Figure size md).
 *   --cell (the dock's wind row): 14 g22. The knots at body semibold (Figure
 *        size sm), "g22" small and grey.
 *   --line (a popup's wind line): → 13 g26 W [shore] · 6.5 m. One line at the
 *        body step, the knots and the wing semibold.
 *
 * The wind's direction is an inline custom property, not a colour:
 * style="--from: 270deg" (where it blows from); the arrow points downwind.
 * Inter with tabular figures throughout. Consumes --sem-* only. */

.wf-wind-figure {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Figure's parts ---- */
/* The mean: Figure md, the figure step. */
.wf-wind-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-figure);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-figure);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-figure);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-figure);
}
/* The gust raised over it. */
.wf-wind-figure__sup {
  align-self: flex-start;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
/* A unit or a quiet word after a figure: kn, m. */
.wf-wind-figure__unit {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
}
/* Alarm: the gust is a big jump over the mean. The warm red, and heavier. */
.wf-wind-figure--alarm .wf-wind-figure__sup {
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* ---- the direction: an arrow blowing downwind, the point it comes from ---- */
.wf-wind-figure__dir {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  align-self: center;
  margin-left: var(--sem-space-x2);
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
  overflow: visible;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow-turn {
  transform: rotate(calc(var(--from, 0deg) + 180deg));
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
/* The compass point, small and grey. Its letters are a name (WSW), not a
 * label set in capitals. */
.wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}

/* ---- --cell: the dock's 14 g22 ---- */
.wf-wind-figure--cell {
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
}
.wf-wind-figure--cell .wf-wind-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.wf-wind-figure__gust {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
}
/* On an ink fill (a selected cell): the fill's words' colour. */
.wf-wind-figure--inverse,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__gust,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__sup,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
}

/* ---- --line: the popup's one line ---- */
.wf-wind-figure--line {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__value,
.wf-wind-figure__wing {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__gust {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__arrow {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.25);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.25);
}
.wf-wind-figure__sep {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}

Wordmark

Wordmark in dark

md, the top bar's

wingfoil.ie

lg, a page about the site

wingfoil.ie

Wordmark in light

md and lg

wingfoil.ie wingfoil.ie

The site's name, wingfoil.ie (ui/Wordmark.tsx, wordmarkStyles): words, not a picture.

Anatomy

  • Mark: .wf-wordmark, "wingfoil" in Fraunces (sem.font.family.display) at sem.font.size.wordmark (23px; sem.font.size.wordmark-sm, 21px, on a phone), semibold, tracked a little tight (sem.font.tracking.title), at the face's 72pt optical size, in sem.color.ink.
  • Domain: .wf-wordmark__domain, ".ie" in Fraunces italic, medium, in the accent (sem.color.chart-magenta).

Variants

  • md (.wf-wordmark, the default): the top bar and the site menu's head.
  • lg (--lg): sem.font.size.title (30px), where a page is about the site itself.

States

  • None of its own. In the top bar it sits in a link home, which takes the one focus ring.

Usage

  • Fraunces belongs to the wordmark and to a spot's name as the title of its own page, and to nothing else: no heading, no name in a list, no figure.
  • Always lower case, always with ".ie", never restyled, recoloured or set in capitals.
  • One wordmark a view, at the left of the [Top bar](../top-bar/component.md).

Accessibility

  • Real text, so it reads as the name it is and scales with the reader's settings.
  • The link round it names where it goes ("wingfoil.ie, the Spot finder").
  • Contrast: the name 18.8:1 (light) and 17.5:1 (dark); ".ie" 6.6:1 and 6.8:1.
components/wordmark/component.css
/* Wordmark — ui/Wordmark.tsx (wordmarkStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes
 * --sem-* only.
 *
 * "wingfoil" in Fraunces, semibold and set a little tight, at its optical
 * size for 72pt, then ".ie" in the accent and Fraunces' italic. With a spot's
 * name as the title of its own page, the only Fraunces on the site. Words,
 * not a picture. */

.wf-wordmark {
  display: inline-block;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-wordmark);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-wordmark);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-title);
  font-variation-settings: "opsz" 72;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (max-width: 719.98px) {
  /* sem.breakpoint.wide: the top bar's mark on a phone. */
  .wf-wordmark {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-wordmark-sm);
    line-height: var(--sem-font-line-wordmark-sm);
  }
}

/* A larger mark, where a page is about the site itself. */
.wf-wordmark--lg,
.wf-wordmark--lg.wf-wordmark {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-title);
  line-height: 1;
}

/* The domain: medium, italic, in the accent. */
.wf-wordmark__domain {
  color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-style: italic;
}
