patterns/dock.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Dock — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/segmented/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/hour-cell/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      /* The favourite: the star in the accent, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }

      /* ---- the dock: a floating sheet at the foot of the map, a sheet's corner at
         the top, no frame; in dark a faint edge as well ---- */
      .dock__map {
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 24);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      .dock {
        position: relative;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-dialog) var(--sem-radius-dialog) 0 0;
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-dock);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      [data-mode="dark"] .dock {
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-dock), 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      /* The phone's grabber: pull the hours up. */
      .dock__grab {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .dock__grab::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        left: 50%;
        width: 36px;
        height: var(--sem-space-x1);
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .dock__grab::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        left: 50%;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 11);
        height: var(--sem-space-x1);
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * -5.5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .dock__grab:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
      }
      /* ---- the head: star, name, compass, then the switch and the one filled action ---- */
      .dock__head {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .dock__head > .wf-button--worded {
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      /* The spot's name in Inter: Fraunces is a spot's name on its own page only. */
      .dock__name {
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .dock__county {
        display: none;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      /* On a phone the verdict takes a line of its own, under the switch. */
      .dock__best {
        order: 4;
        flex-basis: 100%;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dock__acts {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        width: 100%;
      }
      /* ---- the week: five days in a soft card, each a strip of fourteen hours tinted by their stars ---- */
      .dock__week {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x2);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        cursor: ew-resize;
        touch-action: none;
      }
      .dock__week:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .dock__days {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
      .dock__day {
        --pad: var(--sem-space-x1);
        position: relative;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--pad);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .dock__day:first-child {
        border-left: 0;
      }
      .dock__day--on {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .dock__dh {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dock__dn {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .dock__dt,
      .dock__bw {
        display: none;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .dock__dst {
        display: none;
        margin-left: auto;
      }
      /* The phone says a day's best in a figure: 5★. */
      .dock__sn {
        margin-left: auto;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .dock__strip {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(14, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        height: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-mark);
      }
      /* An hour: faintly shaded when it has no stars, the accent by its stars. */
      .dock__h {
        display: block;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-hatch);
        opacity: var(--o, 1);
      }
      .dock__h--s1 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-1); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s2 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-2); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s3 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-3); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s4 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-4); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s5 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-5); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      /* The dark hours: shaded, never rated. */
      .dock__h--night {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-hatch);
      }
      .dock__h--past {
        opacity: calc(var(--o, 1) * var(--sem-opacity-past));
      }
      /* The hand: a thin ink line at the hour shown, the time on a small pill. */
      .dock__hand {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--pad) + (100% - 2 * var(--pad)) * 6.5 / 14);
        width: 0;
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .dock__flag {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        left: var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-inverse);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      /* ---- the hours: the hour-cell table, the chosen hours outlined ---- */
      .dock__hours {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
      }
      .dock__hours table {
        isolation: isolate;
      }
      /* The chosen hours outlined flat in ink, under the figures (src/dock.css
         .tt-shown). */
      .dock__shown {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: -1;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--sem-space-x0-5) var(--sem-color-ink);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .dock__shown--wide {
        display: none;
      }
      /* The tide row: the curve laid out in hours' columns, so it keeps to the table. */
      .dock__tide-cell {
        height: var(--sem-space-x10);
        padding: 0;
      }
      .dock__tide-plot {
        position: relative;
        width: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 10);
        height: var(--sem-space-x10);
      }
      .dock__tide-curve {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: visible;
      }
      .dock__tide-day {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 9);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .dock__turn {
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * var(--x));
        transform: translate(calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) / -2), -50%);
      }
      .dock__turn--end {
        flex-direction: row-reverse;
        transform: translate(calc(-100% + var(--sem-space-x1-5) / 2), -50%);
      }
      .dock__tide-cursor {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 1.5);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-pen);
      }
      .dock__tide-now {
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 1.5 + var(--sem-rule-heavy) / 2);
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        overflow: visible;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      }
      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem): one line of head, the days in full ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        .dock__map {
          height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16);
        }
        .dock {
          padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x2);
        }
        .dock__grab {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__head {
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
        }
        .dock__county {
          display: inline;
        }
        .dock__best {
          order: 0;
          flex-basis: auto;
          margin-left: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
          padding-left: var(--sem-space-x3);
          border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        }
        .dock__acts {
          flex: none;
          width: auto;
          margin-left: auto;
          justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .dock__day {
          --pad: var(--sem-space-x2);
        }
        .dock__dt,
        .dock__bw,
        .dock__dst {
          display: inline-flex;
        }
        .dock__sn {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__shown--phone {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__shown--wide {
          display: block;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>

patterns/listing-card.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Listing card — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tag/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }

      /* ---- the classifieds: two columns on a phone, as many 240px ones as fit wider ---- */
      .lc-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x3);
      }

      /* ---- a listing: its photograph with a card's corner, the words under it on
         the ground. No box round it: the photograph is the card. ---- */
      .lc {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-width: 0;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .lc:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }

      .lc__media {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* No photograph ships with the bundle: a stand-in of shore and sea. */
      .lc__photo {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-land) 0%, var(--sem-color-sea-2) 45%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
        transition: transform var(--sem-duration-base);
      }
      .lc__photo--2 {
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-sea-3) 0%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
      }
      .lc__photo--3 {
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-sea-1) 0%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
      }
      /* Sold is said by the tag as well as by the colour draining out of it. */
      .lc--sold .lc__photo {
        filter: grayscale(1);
      }
      .lc__nophoto {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
      }
      .lc__icon {
        width: var(--sem-space-x6);
        height: var(--sem-space-x6);
      }
      .lc__badge {
        position: absolute;
        top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        left: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .lc__count {
        position: absolute;
        right: var(--sem-space-x2);
        bottom: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .lc__tag-icon {
        width: var(--sem-space-x3);
        height: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }

      .lc__body {
        display: flex;
        flex: 1;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
      }
      /* The price, and "new" in a tag beside it. */
      .lc__head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      /* A sold price, struck through and grey. */
      .lc__sold {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        text-decoration: line-through;
      }
      .lc__title {
        display: -webkit-box;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        text-wrap: balance;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      }
      .lc__where,
      .lc__condition {
        overflow: hidden;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .lc__meta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
        margin-top: auto;
        padding-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .lc__sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* Under the pointer the name underlines and the photograph leans in; nothing lifts. */
      .lc:hover .lc__title,
      .lc.is-hover .lc__title {
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-decoration-thickness: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
        .lc:hover .lc__photo,
        .lc.is-hover .lc__photo {
          transform: scale(1.04);
        }
      }

      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem) ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        .pt {
          padding: var(--sem-space-x8) var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x10);
        }
        .lc-grid {
          grid-template-columns: var(--sem-grid-cards);
          gap: var(--sem-space-x8) var(--sem-space-x5);
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="pt" data-mode="dark">

    <section class="pt" data-mode="light">
      <h2 class="pt__head">The classifieds in light</h2>
      <div class="lc-grid">
        <a class="lc" href="#listing/maharees">
          <span class="lc__media"><span class="lc__photo lc__photo--1" role="presentation"></span><span class="wf-tag wf-tag--glass lc__badge"><svg class="lc__tag-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3 2.8 5.7 6.2.9-4.5 4.4 1.1 6.2L12 17.3 6.4 20.2l1.1-6.2L3 9.6l6.2-.9Z" /></svg>Saved</span><span class="wf-tag wf-tag--glass lc__count"><svg class="lc__tag-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14.5 4h-5L7 7H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v9a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3l-2.5-3z" /><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="3" /></svg><span class="lc__sr">Photos:</span> 3</span></span>
          <span class="lc__body">
            <span class="lc__head"><span class="wf-figure" role="img" aria-label="550 euro"><span class="wf-figure__value">€550</span></span></span>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Spot day — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/heading/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tag/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      /* The favourite: the star in the accent, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }

      /* ---- the day: a section kept apart by space, its table in a soft card ---- */
      .sd {
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x8);
      }
      .sd__head {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 4;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
      }
      .sd__h1 {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
      }
      .sd__best {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      /* The verdict in a line, in the body face. On a phone it takes its own
         line under the head. */
      .sd__pn {
        flex-basis: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
      }
      /* ---- the hours: one row each, ruled in hairlines ---- */
      .sd__wrap {
        position: relative;
      }
      /* ---- the hours: one row each, in a soft card, a hairline between them ---- */
      .sd__rows {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        table-layout: fixed;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .sd__rows th {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        text-align: left;
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: bottom;
      }
      .sd__rows th:first-child,
      .sd__rows td:first-child {
        padding-left: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      /* The ? in a column head: the quiet icon button, drawn small in the head's line. */
      .sd__rows th .wf-button--icon {
        width: var(--sem-space-x5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        margin: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1) 0;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__c-t { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 7.5); }
      .sd__c-st { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16.5); }
      .sd__c-w { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 17); }
      .sd__c-sh { width: var(--sem-space-x10); }
      .sd__c-wg { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 13); }
      .sd__c-wx { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 14.5); }
      .sd__rows td {
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 9.5);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__row {
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .sd__row:hover td {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .sd__row:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
      }
      /* The hour on the chart: a wash of the line colour across its row. */
      .sd__row--sel td {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .sd__row--past td {
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-past);
      }
      .sd__t {
        position: relative;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .sd__from {
        align-items: center;
      }
      .sd__waves,
      .sd__u {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .sd__waves {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .sd__sky {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__sky-cloud,
      .sd__sky-sun {
        fill: var(--sem-color-card);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.1;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      .sd__sky-ray {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.1;
        stroke-linecap: round;
      }
      .sd__air {
        margin-left: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__wide {
        display: none;
      }
      /* ---- the hours: one row each, in a soft card, a hairline between them ---- */
      .sd__rows {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        table-layout: fixed;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      /* The chosen hours outlined flat in ink, under the figures (src/dock.css
         .tt-shown). */
      .sd__shown {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: -1;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x2) * -1);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--sem-space-x0-5) var(--sem-color-ink);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .sd__shown--wide {
        display: none;
      }
      /* ---- the tide over the day, in a soft card: night shaded, the turns marked, the hour in the accent ---- */
      .sd__tide {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .sd__plot {
        position: relative;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .sd__curve {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .sd__night {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: var(--sem-color-hatch);
      }
      .sd__night--twilight {
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-faded);
      }
      .sd__now {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }
      .sd__turn {
        position: absolute;
        transform: translate(calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) / -2), -50%);
      }
      .sd__axis {
        position: relative;
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
      }
      .sd__tick {
        position: absolute;
        top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
      }
      .sd__tick::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1);
        left: 50%;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 0.75);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .sd__tick:first-child {
        transform: none;
      }
      .sd__tick:first-child::before {
        left: 0;
      }
      .sd__tick:last-child {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
      }
      .sd__tick:last-child::before {
        left: auto;
        right: 0;
      }
      /* ---- the turns and the light: two small tables, each in a soft card ---- */
      .sd__tabs {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        max-width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 140);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .sd__mini {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
      }
      .sd__mini td {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .sd__mini tr + tr td {
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .sd__n {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        text-align: right;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .sd__sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem): the shore, wing and waves come in ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        /* Every column keeps its width; the waves take what is left over. */
        .sd {
          max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
          padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x8) var(--sem-space-x10);
        }
        .sd__pn {
          flex-basis: auto;
        }
        .sd__wide {
          display: table-cell;
        }
        .sd__c-dr {
          width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 20);
        }
        .sd__rows td {
          height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 8.5);
        }
        .sd__shown--phone {
          display: none;
        }
        .sd__shown--wide {
          display: block;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="pt" data-mode="dark">
      <h2 class="pt__head">A spot's day in dark</h2>
      <p class="pt__label">A spot page, one day, Brandon Bay</p>
      <section class="sd" aria-labelledby="sd-day-6">
        <div class="wf-heading sd__head">

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Spot popup — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/card/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/spot-light/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      /* The favourite: the star in the accent, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }

      /* ---- the chart under it: sea, a coast, the other lights gone quiet ---- */
      .pop__map {
        min-height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 110);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x10) var(--sem-space-x3) 0;
      }
      .pop__land {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .pop__coast {
        fill: var(--sem-color-land);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
        stroke-width: 1;
        vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
      }
      .pop__other {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 92);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 22);
      }
      .pop__stack {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
      }

      /* ---- the popup: a floating card, no frame, no tip ---- */
      .pop {
        position: relative;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 68);
        padding: 14px var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .pop__head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .pop__head > .wf-button {
        margin-top: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1);
      }
      .pop__head > .wf-button:first-child {
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-x2) * -1);
      }
      .pop__head > .wf-button:last-child {
        margin-right: calc(var(--sem-space-x2) * -1);
      }
      .pop__words {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      /* The name in Inter: Fraunces is a spot's name on its own page only. */
      .pop__name {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pop__meta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        margin: var(--sem-space-x0-5) 0 0;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
      }
      /* The hour's figures: a grey label over each, no rules. */
      .pop__figs {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin: var(--sem-space-x3) 0 0;
      }
      .pop__fig {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 12) minmax(0, 1fr);
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .pop__label {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      .pop__value {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pop__acts {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }

      /* ---- the light it points at, selected (spot-light --sel) ---- */
      .pop__spot {
        position: relative;
        width: var(--sem-space-x5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x6);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="pt" data-mode="dark">
      <h2 class="pt__head">The spot popup in dark</h2>
      <p class="pt__label">A floating card over the chart, Fri 11:00, the spot in focus</p>
      <div class="pt__map pop__map wf-spot-light-field--focus">
        <svg class="pop__land" viewBox="0 0 390 560" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path class="pop__coast" d="M0 0H150C168 60 132 120 150 190C162 240 196 262 186 318C178 370 132 392 118 450C108 500 70 530 0 560Z" /></svg>
        <div class="pop__other"><button class="wf-spot-light wf-spot-light--s2" type="button" aria-label="Donabate: 2 stars, WSW 11 knots" style="--from: 247deg">
                  <svg class="wf-spot-light__glyph" viewBox="-30 -30 60 60" aria-hidden="true"><g class="wf-spot-light__wind"><path class="wf-spot-light__arrow" d="M0 -9.6V-20.5M-3.4 -16.6L0 -21L3.4 -16.6" /></g><circle class="wf-spot-light__ring" r="7.6" /><line class="wf-spot-light__strike" x1="-5.6" y1="5.6" x2="5.6" y2="-5.6" /><text class="wf-spot-light__n" y="3.4" text-anchor="middle">2</text></svg>
                  <span class="wf-spot-light__label" aria-hidden="true"><span class="wf-spot-light__name">Donabate</span><span class="wf-spot-light__line">2★ WSW 11</span></span>
                </button></div>
        <div class="pop__stack">
          <div class="wf-card wf-card--float pop" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="pop-d-name">
            <div class="pop__head">
              <button class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon wf-button--sm wf-button--worded" type="button" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Unstar Dollymount"><svg class="fav" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path class="fav__path" d="M8 1.3 L10 6.1 L15.1 6.5 L11.2 9.8 L12.5 14.8 L8 12.1 L3.6 14.9 L4.8 9.9 L0.9 6.6 L6 6.1 Z" /></svg></button>
              <div class="pop__words">
                <h3 class="pop__name" id="pop-d-name">Dollymount</h3>
                <p class="pop__meta"><svg class="wf-shore-compass wf-shore-compass--sm" viewBox="-10 -10 20 20" role="img" aria-label="Beach faces SE, 123°" style="--facing: 123deg"><title>Beach faces SE, 123°</title><circle class="wf-shore-compass__disc" r="8.8" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__north" d="M0 -8.8V-6.4" /><g class="wf-shore-compass__face"><path class="wf-shore-compass__sea" d="M0 -7.6L3.1 .2H-3.1Z" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__beach" d="M-5.2 3H5.2" /></g></svg><span>Dublin, Fri 11:00</span></p>
              </div>
              <button class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon wf-button--sm" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg class="wf-button__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18" /><path d="m6 6 12 12" /></svg></button>
            </div>
            <dl class="pop__figs">
              <div class="pop__fig"><dt class="pop__label">Stars</dt><dd class="pop__value"><svg class="wf-star-glyphs wf-star-glyphs--ink" width="73" height="13" viewBox="0 0 73 13" role="img" aria-label="3 of 5 stars, 5 on the wind alone"><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(6.5 6.9) scale(1.25)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(21.5 6.9) scale(1.25)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(36.5 6.9) scale(1.25)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__faded" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" stroke-width="0.76" transform="translate(51.5 6.9) scale(1.25)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__faded" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" stroke-width="0.76" transform="translate(66.5 6.9) scale(1.25)" /></svg><a class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon wf-button--sm" href="#stars" aria-label="How the stars work"><svg class="wf-button__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" /><path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3" /><path d="M12 17h.01" /></svg></a></dd></div>
              <div class="pop__fig"><dt class="pop__label">Wind</dt><dd class="pop__value"><span class="wf-wind-figure wf-wind-figure--line" role="img" aria-label="13 knots gusting 26 from the west, cross-offshore, 6.5 m wing"><svg class="wf-wind-figure__arrow" viewBox="-7 -7 14 14" aria-hidden="true" style="--from: 270deg"><g class="wf-wind-figure__arrow-turn"><path class="wf-wind-figure__arrow-path" d="M0 5.5V-5.2M-3 -1.8L0 -5.6L3 -1.8" /></g></svg><span class="wf-wind-figure__value">13</span><span class="wf-wind-figure__gust">g26</span><span class="wf-wind-figure__point">W</span><svg class="wf-shore-compass wf-shore-compass--wind wf-shore-compass--cross-off" viewBox="-9 -9 18 18" role="img" aria-label="cross-offshore" style="--facing: 123deg; --from: 270deg"><title>cross-offshore</title><rect class="wf-shore-compass__land" x="-9" y="4.2" width="18" height="4.8" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__hatch" d="M-6.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M-4 4.2l-4.6 4.6M-1.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M1 4.2l-4.6 4.6M3.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M6 4.2l-4.6 4.6M8.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M11 4.2l-4.6 4.6M13.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__shore" d="M-9 4.2H9" /><g class="wf-shore-compass__wind"><path class="wf-shore-compass__arrow" d="M0 5V-5.2M-2.6 -2.3L0 -5.5L2.6 -2.3" /></g></svg><span class="wf-wind-figure__sep">·</span><span><span class="wf-wind-figure__wing">6.5</span> m</span></span></dd></div>
              <div class="pop__fig"><dt class="pop__label">Tide</dt><dd class="pop__value"><span class="wf-tide-label wf-tide-label--line" role="img" aria-label="Tide 4.1 m"><svg class="wf-tide-label__wave" viewBox="0 0 14 8" aria-hidden="true"><path class="wf-tide-label__wave-path" d="M0 5 Q3.5 0 7 4 T14 3" /></svg>4.1 m</span></dd></div>
            </dl>
            <div class="pop__acts"><a class="wf-button wf-button--primary wf-button--sm" href="#spot/dollymount">Spot page</a></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pop__spot">
                <button class="wf-spot-light wf-spot-light--s3 wf-spot-light--xoff wf-spot-light--sel" type="button" aria-label="Dollymount, Dublin: 11:00 3 stars, W 13 knots, cross-offshore" style="--from: 270deg">
                  <svg class="wf-spot-light__glyph" viewBox="-30 -30 60 60" aria-hidden="true"><g class="wf-spot-light__wind"><path class="wf-spot-light__arrow" d="M0 -9.6V-20.5M-3.4 -16.6L0 -21L3.4 -16.6" /></g><circle class="wf-spot-light__ring" r="7.6" /><line class="wf-spot-light__strike" x1="-5.6" y1="5.6" x2="5.6" y2="-5.6" /><text class="wf-spot-light__n" y="3.4" text-anchor="middle">3</text></svg>
                  <span class="wf-spot-light__label" aria-hidden="true"><span class="wf-spot-light__name">Dollymount</span><span class="wf-spot-light__line">3★ W 13 · cross-off</span></span>
                </button>
              </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="pt" data-mode="light">
      <h2 class="pt__head">The spot popup in light</h2>
      <div class="pt__map pop__map wf-spot-light-field--focus">

              <div class="pop__fig"><dt class="pop__label">Wind</dt><dd class="pop__value"><span class="wf-wind-figure wf-wind-figure--line" role="img" aria-label="13 knots gusting 26 from the west, cross-offshore, 6.5 m wing"><svg class="wf-wind-figure__arrow" viewBox="-7 -7 14 14" aria-hidden="true" style="--from: 270deg"><g class="wf-wind-figure__arrow-turn"><path class="wf-wind-figure__arrow-path" d="M0 5.5V-5.2M-3 -1.8L0 -5.6L3 -1.8" /></g></svg><span class="wf-wind-figure__value">13</span><span class="wf-wind-figure__gust">g26</span><span class="wf-wind-figure__point">W</span><svg class="wf-shore-compass wf-shore-compass--wind wf-shore-compass--cross-off" viewBox="-9 -9 18 18" role="img" aria-label="cross-offshore" style="--facing: 123deg; --from: 270deg"><title>cross-offshore</title><rect class="wf-shore-compass__land" x="-9" y="4.2" width="18" height="4.8" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__hatch" d="M-6.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M-4 4.2l-4.6 4.6M-1.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M1 4.2l-4.6 4.6M3.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M6 4.2l-4.6 4.6M8.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6M11 4.2l-4.6 4.6M13.5 4.2l-4.6 4.6" /><path class="wf-shore-compass__shore" d="M-9 4.2H9" /><g class="wf-shore-compass__wind"><path class="wf-shore-compass__arrow" d="M0 5V-5.2M-2.6 -2.3L0 -5.5L2.6 -2.3" /></g></svg><span class="wf-wind-figure__sep">·</span><span><span class="wf-wind-figure__wing">6.5</span> m</span></span></dd></div>

                <button class="wf-spot-light wf-spot-light--s3 wf-spot-light--xoff wf-spot-light--sel" type="button" aria-label="Dollymount, Dublin: 11:00 3 stars, W 13 knots, cross-offshore" style="--from: 270deg">
                  <svg class="wf-spot-light__glyph" viewBox="-30 -30 60 60" aria-hidden="true"><g class="wf-spot-light__wind"><path class="wf-spot-light__arrow" d="M0 -9.6V-20.5M-3.4 -16.6L0 -21L3.4 -16.6" /></g><circle class="wf-spot-light__ring" r="7.6" /><line class="wf-spot-light__strike" x1="-5.6" y1="5.6" x2="5.6" y2="-5.6" /><text class="wf-spot-light__n" y="3.4" text-anchor="middle">3</text></svg>

patterns/your-spots.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Your spots — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/card/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tabs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      /* The favourite: the star in the accent, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }

      /* ---- the panel: a floating card, tabs, two lists ---- */
      .ys {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 80);
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .ys__top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .ys__when {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A list's small grey name; space above it, no rule. */
      .ys__h {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        min-height: var(--sem-space-x8);
        margin: var(--sem-space-x3) 0 0;
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      .ys__list {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .ys__row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: var(--sem-space-x8) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
      }
      .ys__row:hover {
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .ys__go {
        display: block;
        min-width: 0;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .ys__go:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .ys__name {
        display: block;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .ys__line {
        display: block;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ys__none {
        margin: 0;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x1);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
      }
      .ys__sign {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
      }
      .ys__sign-acts {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }

      /* ---- the phone's strip: the starred spots side by side ---- */
      .ys-strip {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) var(--sem-space-x3);
        overflow-x: auto;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }
      .ys-strip__best {
        flex: none;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      .ys-strip__list {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .ys-strip__item {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ys-strip__name {
        color: inherit;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        text-decoration: none;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>

              </li>

                <a class="ys__go" href="#map/brandon-bay"><span class="ys__name">Brandon Bay</span><span class="ys__line">No stars, SW 10 g15</span></a>
                <svg class="wf-star-glyphs wf-star-glyphs--ink" width="54" height="10" viewBox="0 0 54 10" role="img" aria-label="0 of 5 stars, 2 on the wind alone"><path class="wf-star-glyphs__faded" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" stroke-width="0.988" transform="translate(5 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__faded" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" stroke-width="0.988" transform="translate(16 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><circle class="wf-star-glyphs__dot" cx="27" cy="5" r="0.7" /><circle class="wf-star-glyphs__dot" cx="38" cy="5" r="0.7" /><circle class="wf-star-glyphs__dot" cx="49" cy="5" r="0.7" /></svg>

                <button class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon wf-button--sm wf-button--worded" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Star The Burrow"><svg class="fav" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path class="fav__path" d="M8 1.3 L10 6.1 L15.1 6.5 L11.2 9.8 L12.5 14.8 L8 12.1 L3.6 14.9 L4.8 9.9 L0.9 6.6 L6 6.1 Z" /></svg></button>

                <svg class="wf-star-glyphs wf-star-glyphs--ink" width="54" height="10" viewBox="0 0 54 10" role="img" aria-label="5 of 5 stars"><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(5 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(16 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(27 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(38 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /><path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" transform="translate(49 5.4) scale(0.9615)" /></svg>
              </li>
            </ul>
            <div class="ys__sign"><span>On this device</span><span class="ys__sign-acts"><button class="wf-button wf-button--sm" type="button">Sign in</button><button class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon wf-button--sm" type="button" aria-label="About your spots"><svg class="wf-button__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" /><path d="M12 16v-4" /><path d="M12 8h.01" /></svg></button></span></div>
