patterns/your-stars.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Your star rating — wingfoil pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/dialog/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/segmented/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/heading/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/link/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/field/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/text-input/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/select/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: the ground, a grey label over each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pt {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x6) 0 var(--sem-space-x8);
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__head {
        margin: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
      }
      /* A stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea);
      }
      /* The favourite: the star in the accent, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }

      .pt__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x6);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .pt__col {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .pt__units {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      /* ---- the dialog: the system's own, sized for the page and for a phone ---- */
      .ys.wf-dialog {
        position: static;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 124);
        max-width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      .ys--phone.wf-dialog {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 97.5);
      }
      .ys__block + .ys__block {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x6);
      }
      .ys__presets {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      /* ---- the two curves: stars for the wind, stars off for the gusts ---- */
      .curve {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        overflow: visible;
      }
      .curve__grid {
        stroke: var(--sem-color-line);
        stroke-width: 1;
      }
      .curve__base {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
        stroke-width: 1.25;
        stroke-dasharray: 3 3;
      }
      .curve__yours {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 2;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      .curve__under {
        fill: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .curve__axis {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: 10px; /* ds-lint-allow: SVG user units at the eyebrow's size */
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .legend {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x4);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .legend__key {
        display: inline-block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 5);
        margin-right: var(--sem-space-x1);
        vertical-align: middle;
        border-top: 2px solid var(--sem-color-ink); /* ds-lint-allow: the curve's own stroke width */
      }
      .legend__key--base {
        border-top: 1.25px dashed var(--sem-color-line-strong); /* ds-lint-allow: the curve's own stroke */
      }
      /* ---- a scale of handles under each curve ---- */
      .band {
        position: relative;
        height: var(--sem-size-touch);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .band__scale {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        top: 50%;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1);
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        opacity: 0.35;
      }
      /* The wind's own colours along the knots, faint: 0 to 40 kn under the wind, 0 to 50 under the gusts. */
      .band__scale--wind {
        background: linear-gradient(
          to right,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k00) 0%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k05) 12.5%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k10) 25%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k15) 37.5%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k20) 50%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k25) 62.5%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k30) 75%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k35) 87.5%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k40) 100%
        );
      }
      .band__scale--gust {
        background: linear-gradient(
          to right,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k00) 0%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k10) 20%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k20) 40%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k30) 60%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k40) 80%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k45) 90%,
          var(--sem-color-wind-k50) 100%
        );
      }
      .band__fill,
      .band__edge {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1);
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        background: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .band__edge {
        opacity: 0.35;
      }
      .band input[type="range"] {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        background: none;
        pointer-events: none;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        appearance: none;
      }
      .band input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
        background: none;
      }
      .band input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 2.5);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 5);
        border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-card);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-control);
        cursor: ew-resize;
        pointer-events: auto;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        appearance: none;
      }
      .band input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 2.5);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 5);
        border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-card);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-control);
        cursor: ew-resize;
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      .band input[type="range"]:focus-visible {
        outline: none;
      }
      .band input[type="range"]:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .band input[type="range"]:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .figs {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .figs--three {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
      .fig {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
      }
      .fig__name {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .fig__value {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-figure);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-figure);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-figure);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .fig__value small {
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .fig .wf-segmented {
        align-self: flex-start;
      }
      /* ---- wind direction: the beach, and the stars each direction costs ---- */
      .shore {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 96);
        height: auto;
        margin: var(--sem-space-x1) auto 0;
      }
      .shore__land {
        fill: var(--sem-color-land);
        opacity: 0.7;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .shore__sea {
        fill: var(--sem-color-depth);
        opacity: 0.22;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .shore__line {
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 2;
      }
      .shore__wedge {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-card);
        stroke-width: 1;
      }
      .shore__ring {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1;
      }
      .shore__word {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: 9px; /* ds-lint-allow: SVG user units, a small label inside the drawing */
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .shore__word--on-dark {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
      }
      .web__spoke {
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 0.5;
        opacity: 0.12;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web__ringline {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 0.5;
        opacity: 0.18;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web__shape {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
        fill-opacity: 0.07;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.25;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web__slice {
        fill: transparent;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .web__slice--on {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
        fill-opacity: 0.08;
      }
      .web__dot {
        fill: var(--sem-color-card);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.5;
        cursor: grab;
      }
      .web__dot--on {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .web__dot:focus-visible {
        outline: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-focus);
        stroke-width: 3;
      }
      .web__half {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: 7.5px; /* ds-lint-allow: SVG user units, a small label inside the drawing */
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web__name {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: 8px; /* ds-lint-allow: SVG user units, a small label inside the drawing */
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web__ring-label {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: 6.5px; /* ds-lint-allow: SVG user units, the rings' small figures */
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web .shore__word {
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .web {
        touch-action: none;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .picked {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
      }
      .picked__name {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
      }
      .picked__value {
        min-width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 10);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-figure);
        text-align: center;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .together__for {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
      }
      /* ---- together: every wind and gust, rated ---- */
      .grid {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        overflow: visible;
        touch-action: none;
        cursor: crosshair;
      }
      .grid__cell {
        fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .grid__none {
        fill: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .grid__pick {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-focus);
        stroke-width: 2;
      }
      .grid__key {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .grid__swatch {
        display: inline-block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3);
        background: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .readout {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-height: var(--sem-size-control-sm);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .readout__why {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* ---- examples: the level they started from, against theirs ---- */
      .rates {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .rates th {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        text-align: left;
      }
      .rates td {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .rates tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: 0;
      }
      .rates__w {
        width: 34%;
      }
      .rates__s {
        width: 30%;
      }
      .rates__moved {
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      /* The rider settings: rows in one soft card, a hairline between them. */
      .settings {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 90);
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x4);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-surface);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .settings__row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) 0;
      }
      .settings__row + .settings__row {
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .settings__name {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .settings__value {
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
      }
      .settings__actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        align-items: center;
      }
      /* The dock's head over the map: a floating sheet, no frame. */
      .dockhead {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 90);
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x4);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-dialog) var(--sem-radius-dialog) 0 0;
        background: var(--sem-color-ground);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-dock);
      }
      [data-mode="dark"] .dockhead {
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-dock), 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .dockhead__top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .dockhead__spot {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-lead);
      }
      /* The chip that says the stars are the rider's own, and opens the dialog. */
      .whose {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x8);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
        border: 0;
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .whose:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .hours {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .hour {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .hour + .hour {
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .hour__ist {
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .hour .wf-star-glyphs {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 14);
        height: auto;
      }

      /* A block's small grey name, in sentence case. */
      .ys__label {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: var(--sem-space-x2);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-2);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="pt" data-mode="dark">
      <h2 class="pt__head">Your star rating in dark</h2>
      <p class="pt__label">Demo only: the rider's unit setting, which every figure, axis and handle follows</p>
      <div class="pt__units">
        <div class="wf-segmented" role="group" aria-label="Wind units">
          <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-unit="kn" aria-pressed="true">kn</button>
          <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-unit="mph" aria-pressed="false">mph</button>
          <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-unit="kmh" aria-pressed="false">km/h</button>
          <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-unit="ms" aria-pressed="false">m/s</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="pt__label">1. Where it opens: the rider settings (Display ▸ You), before and after</p>
      <div class="pt__row">
        <div class="settings" aria-label="Rider settings, standard stars">
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Level</span>
            <span class="settings__value">Riding</span>
          </div>
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Star rating</span>
            <span class="settings__actions"><span class="settings__value">Standard for Riding</span><a class="wf-link" href="#">Customise</a></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="settings" aria-label="Rider settings, custom stars">
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Level</span>
            <span class="settings__value">Riding</span>
          </div>
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Star rating</span>
            <span class="settings__actions"><span class="settings__value">Custom</span><a class="wf-link" href="#">Edit</a><a class="wf-link" href="#">Reset</a></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="pt__label">2. The dialog on a computer: a rider who wants about 20 knots, and no gusts much over 25</p>
      <div class="pt__row">
        <div data-ys data-start="intermediate" data-custom='{"min":15,"sweetLow":18,"sweetHigh":23,"max":27,"fine":24,"worst":30,"most":3,"dir":{"onshore":0.5,"crossOn":0,"cross":0,"crossOff":2.5,"offshore":4}}'></div>
        <div class="pt__col">
          <p class="pt__label" style="margin: 0">3. The forecast, once saved: a chip says the stars are custom, and opens the dialog</p>
          <div class="dockhead">
            <div class="dockhead__top">
              <span class="dockhead__spot">Dollymount Strand</span>
              <button class="whose" type="button" aria-label="Custom star rating: edit">
                <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="-5 -5 10 10" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" /></svg>
                Custom stars
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="hours" data-hours></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="pt__label">4. The dialog on a phone, 390 wide, opened from a Learning level, nothing changed yet</p>
      <div class="pt__row">
        <div data-ys data-start="beginner" data-phone></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="pt" data-mode="light">
      <h2 class="pt__head">Your star rating in light</h2>
      <p class="pt__label">1. Where it opens: the rider settings (Display ▸ You), before and after</p>
      <div class="pt__row">
        <div class="settings" aria-label="Rider settings, standard stars">
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Level</span>
            <span class="settings__value">Riding</span>
          </div>
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Star rating</span>
            <span class="settings__actions"><span class="settings__value">Standard for Riding</span><a class="wf-link" href="#">Customise</a></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="settings" aria-label="Rider settings, custom stars">
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Level</span>
            <span class="settings__value">Riding</span>
          </div>
          <div class="settings__row">
            <span class="settings__name">Star rating</span>
            <span class="settings__actions"><span class="settings__value">Custom</span><a class="wf-link" href="#">Edit</a><a class="wf-link" href="#">Reset</a></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="pt__label">3. The forecast, once saved: a chip says the stars are custom</p>
      <div class="pt__row">
        <div class="dockhead">
              <div class="dockhead__top">
                <span class="dockhead__spot">Dollymount Strand</span>
                <button class="whose" type="button" aria-label="Custom star rating: edit">
                  <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="-5 -5 10 10" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z" /></svg>
                  Custom stars
                </button>
              </div>
              <div class="hours"></div>
            </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <template id="ys">
      <div class="wf-dialog wf-dialog--wide ys" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
        <div class="wf-dialog__head">
          <h2 class="wf-dialog__title" data-title>Your star rating</h2>
          <button class="wf-button wf-button--quiet wf-button--icon" type="button" aria-label="Close">
            <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18" /><path d="m6 6 12 12" /></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="wf-dialog__body">
          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Start from</span>
            <div class="wf-segmented ys__presets" role="group" aria-label="Start from">
              <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-preset="beginner">Learning</button>
              <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-preset="intermediate">Riding</button>
              <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-preset="advanced">Advanced</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Wind speed: stars</span>
            <svg class="curve" viewBox="0 0 400 92" role="img" data-curve="wind"></svg>
            <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true">
              <span><span class="legend__key"></span>Yours</span>
              <span><span class="legend__key legend__key--base"></span><span data-base-name></span></span>
            </div>
            <div class="band">
              <div class="band__scale band__scale--wind"></div>
              <div class="band__edge" data-span="min-sweetLow"></div>
              <div class="band__fill" data-span="sweetLow-sweetHigh"></div>
              <div class="band__edge" data-span="sweetHigh-max"></div>
              <input type="range" data-k="min" aria-label="Minimum wind speed" />
              <input type="range" data-k="sweetLow" aria-label="Ideal wind speed from" />
              <input type="range" data-k="sweetHigh" aria-label="Ideal wind speed to" />
              <input type="range" data-k="max" aria-label="Maximum wind speed" />
            </div>
            <div class="figs">
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">Minimum</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="min"></span></div>
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">Ideal from</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="sweetLow"></span></div>
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">Ideal to</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="sweetHigh"></span></div>
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">Maximum</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="max"></span></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Gusts: stars taken off</span>
            <svg class="curve" viewBox="0 0 400 92" role="img" data-curve="gust"></svg>
            <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true">
              <span><span class="legend__key"></span>Yours</span>
              <span><span class="legend__key legend__key--base"></span><span data-base-name></span></span>
            </div>
            <div class="band">
              <div class="band__scale band__scale--gust"></div>
              <div class="band__fill" data-span="fine-worst" data-scale="gust"></div>
              <input type="range" data-k="fine" aria-label="Gusts have no effect up to" />
              <input type="range" data-k="worst" aria-label="Gusts take off the most from" />
            </div>
            <div class="figs figs--three">
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">No effect up to</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="fine"></span></div>
              <div class="fig"><span class="fig__name">Most off from</span><span class="fig__value" data-v="worst"></span></div>
              <div class="fig">
                <span class="fig__name">Most off</span>
                <div class="wf-segmented" role="group" aria-label="The most the gusts take off">
                  <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-most="1">1★</button>
                  <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-most="2">2★</button>
                  <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-most="3">3★</button>
                  <button class="wf-segmented__item" type="button" data-most="5">All</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Wind direction: stars taken off</span>
            <svg class="shore web" viewBox="-180 -128 360 256" role="group" aria-label="Stars taken off for each wind direction" data-shore></svg>
            <div class="picked" data-picked>
              <span class="picked__name" data-picked-name></span>
              <button class="wf-button wf-button--icon wf-button--sm" type="button" data-step="1" aria-label="Take off half a star more">−</button>
              <span class="picked__value" data-picked-value></span>
              <button class="wf-button wf-button--icon wf-button--sm" type="button" data-step="-1" aria-label="Take off half a star less">+</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Together: wind speed, gusts and direction</span>
            <div class="together__for">
              <span>For wind that is</span>
              <div class="wf-select">
                <select class="wf-select__input" aria-label="Show the stars for wind that is" data-for></select>
                <svg class="wf-select__chevron" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>
              </div>
            </div>
            <svg class="grid" viewBox="0 -18 400 278" role="img" data-grid></svg>
            <div class="grid__key" aria-hidden="true">
              <span>Blank: no stars ·</span><span>1★</span><span class="grid__swatch" style="opacity: 0.08"></span><span class="grid__swatch" style="opacity: 0.25"></span><span class="grid__swatch" style="opacity: 0.45"></span><span class="grid__swatch" style="opacity: 0.65"></span><span class="grid__swatch" style="opacity: 0.85"></span><span>5★</span>
            </div>
            <div class="readout" aria-live="polite" data-readout></div>
          </div>

          <div class="ys__block">
            <span class="ys__label">Examples</span>
            <table class="rates">
              <thead>
                <tr><th scope="col" class="rates__w" data-forecast-head></th><th scope="col" class="rates__s" data-base-name></th><th scope="col">Yours</th></tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody data-rates></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="wf-dialog__actions">
          <button class="wf-button" type="button">Cancel</button>
          <button class="wf-button wf-button--primary" type="button">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <script>
      // The proposed rating (a change to force5/src/stars.ts): stars for the wind speed, less
      // stars for how strong the gusts are, both curves set by the rider. Below the minimum a
      // gust still lifts the wind towards it: a light day with gusts is a chance to get up.
      const LEVELS = {
        beginner: { name: "Learning", min: 13, sweetLow: 15, sweetHigh: 20, max: 24, fine: 20, worst: 28, most: 3, share: 0.2,
          dir: { onshore: 1, crossOn: 0, cross: 0.5, crossOff: 3, offshore: 5 } },
        intermediate: { name: "Riding", min: 11, sweetLow: 14, sweetHigh: 24, max: 30, fine: 28, worst: 40, most: 2, share: 0.3,
          dir: { onshore: 1, crossOn: 0, cross: 0, crossOff: 1.5, offshore: 4 } },
        advanced: { name: "Advanced", min: 8, sweetLow: 13, sweetHigh: 28, max: 35, fine: 33, worst: 45, most: 2, share: 0.35,
          dir: { onshore: 1, crossOn: 0, cross: 0, crossOff: 1, offshore: 4 } },
      };
      // How the wind meets the beach, as stars.ts's shoreAngle reads it, drawn the way the wind
      // blows: offshore points out over the sea (up), onshore in over the land (down). `from`/`to`
      // are degrees off straight out to sea; `at` is where its dot sits, on each side for the
      // four that come from either side.
      const DIRS = [
        { key: "offshore", name: "Offshore", from: 0, to: 30, at: [0] },
        { key: "crossOff", name: "Cross-offshore", from: 30, to: 70, at: [50, -50] },
        { key: "cross", name: "Cross-shore", from: 70, to: 110, at: [90, -90] },
        { key: "crossOn", name: "Cross-onshore", from: 110, to: 150, at: [130, -130] },
        { key: "onshore", name: "Onshore", from: 150, to: 180, at: [180] },
      ];
      const half = (v) => (v ? `−${Math.floor(v) || ""}${v % 1 ? "½" : ""}` : "0");
      const DIR_WORD = { onshore: "onshore", crossOn: "cross-on", cross: "cross", crossOff: "cross-off", offshore: "offshore" };
      const WIND_KEYS = ["min", "sweetLow", "sweetHigh", "max"];
      const GUST_KEYS = ["fine", "worst"];
      const WIND_TOP = 40, GUST_TOP = 50; // knots: the ends of the two scales
      const clamp = (x, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x));
      const ramp = (x, x0, x1, y0, y1) => y0 + ((clamp(x, x0, x1) - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * (y1 - y0);
      function windScore(kn, b) {
        if (kn < b.min - 2) return 0;
        if (kn < b.min) return ramp(kn, b.min - 2, b.min, 0, 1);
        if (kn < b.sweetLow) return ramp(kn, b.min, b.sweetLow, 1, 4);
        if (kn <= b.sweetHigh) {
          const q = (b.sweetHigh - b.sweetLow) / 4;
          if (kn < b.sweetLow + q) return ramp(kn, b.sweetLow, b.sweetLow + q, 4, 5);
          if (kn > b.sweetHigh - q) return ramp(kn, b.sweetHigh - q, b.sweetHigh, 5, 4);
          return 5;
        }
        if (kn <= b.max) return ramp(kn, b.sweetHigh, b.max, 4, 2);
        return ramp(kn, b.max, b.max + 6, 2, 0);
      }
      const gustLoss = (kn, b) => (kn <= b.fine ? 0 : ramp(kn, b.fine, b.worst, 0, b.most));
      function rate(wind, gust, b, dir = "crossOn") {
        const ride = gust > wind && wind < b.min ? Math.min(b.min, wind + b.share * Math.min(gust - wind, wind)) : wind;
        const base = windScore(ride, b);
        const potential = Math.round(base);
        const loss = gustLoss(gust, b);
        const off = b.dir[dir];
        const stars = clamp(Math.round(base - loss - off), 0, potential);
        return { stars, potential, base, loss, off };
      }

      // The beach from above, sea up and land down, and a dot for each way the wind can blow,
      // drawn where it blows to: on the rim it takes nothing off, at the middle all five stars,
      // in half stars. A line through the dots shows the directions the rider likes.
      const R = 100;
      const polar = (a, r) => [r * Math.sin((a * Math.PI) / 180), -r * Math.cos((a * Math.PI) / 180)];
      const radius = (off) => R * (1 - off / 5);
      function web(svg, b, picked) {
        const f = (n) => n.toFixed(1);
        const wedge = (a1, a2) => { const [x1, y1] = polar(a1, R), [x2, y2] = polar(a2, R); return `M0,0 L${f(x1)},${f(y1)} A${R},${R} 0 0 1 ${f(x2)},${f(y2)}Z`; };
        const arcs = (d) => (d.from === 0 ? [[-30, 30]] : d.to === 180 ? [[150, 210]] : [[d.from, d.to], [-d.to, -d.from]]);
        // Sea and land only inside the circle; the ground round it.
        let out = `<path class="shore__sea" d="M${-R},0 A${R},${R} 0 0 1 ${R},0Z"/><path class="shore__land" d="M${R},0 A${R},${R} 0 0 1 ${-R},0Z"/>`;
        DIRS.forEach((d) => arcs(d).forEach(([a1, a2]) => {
          out += `<path class="web__slice${d.key === picked ? " web__slice--on" : ""}" d="${wedge(a1, a2)}" data-slice="${d.key}"><title>${d.name}</title></path>`;
        }));
        for (let off = 1; off <= 4; off++) out += `<circle class="web__ringline" r="${radius(off)}"/>`;
        [30, 70, 110, 150].forEach((a) => [a, -a].forEach((aa) => { const [x, y] = polar(aa, R); out += `<line class="web__spoke" x1="0" y1="0" x2="${f(x)}" y2="${f(y)}"/>`; }));
        for (let off = 1; off <= 4; off++) { const [x, y] = polar(-30, radius(off)); out += `<text class="web__ring-label" x="${f(x - 2)}" y="${f(y - 2)}" text-anchor="end">−${off}</text>`; }
        out += `<circle class="shore__ring" r="${R}"/><line class="shore__line" x1="${-R - 8}" x2="${R + 8}" y1="0" y2="0"/>`;
        out += `<text class="web__half" x="${-R + 14}" y="-8">sea</text><text class="web__half" x="${-R + 14}" y="15">land</text>`;
        const ring = [0, 50, 90, 130, 180, -130, -90, -50].map((a) => { const d = DIRS.find((x) => x.at.includes(a)); return polar(a, radius(b.dir[d.key])); });
        out += `<polygon class="web__shape" points="${ring.map(([x, y]) => `${f(x)},${f(y)}`).join(" ")}"/>`;
        // Names round the outside: once, on the right, for the four that come from either side.
        DIRS.forEach((d) => {
          const a = d.at[0], [x, y] = polar(a, R + 12);
          if (a === 0) out += `<text class="web__name" x="0" y="${f(y - 2)}" text-anchor="middle">${d.name}</text>`;
          else if (a === 180) out += `<text class="web__name" x="0" y="${f(y + 9)}" text-anchor="middle">${d.name}</text>`;
          else out += `<text class="web__name" x="${f(x)}" y="${f(a === 90 ? y - 5 : y + 3)}">${d.name}</text>`;
        });
        // The dots last, the picked direction's on top.
        const order = [...DIRS].sort((x, y) => (x.key === picked) - (y.key === picked));
        order.forEach((d) => d.at.forEach((a, n) => {
          const [x, y] = polar(a, radius(b.dir[d.key]));
          const on = d.key === picked;
          out += `<circle class="web__dot${on ? " web__dot--on" : ""}" cx="${f(x)}" cy="${f(y)}" r="${on ? 5 : 4}" data-dot="${d.key}"` +
            (n === 0 ? ` tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="${d.name}: stars taken off" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="5" aria-valuenow="${b.dir[d.key]}" aria-valuetext="${half(b.dir[d.key])} stars"` : ` aria-hidden="true"`) + `/>`;
        }));
        svg.innerHTML = out;
      }


      // Units: everything is kept in knots and shown in the rider's unit.
      const UNITS = {
        kn: { label: "kn", per: 1, step: 1, dp: 0 },
        mph: { label: "mph", per: 1.15078, step: 1, dp: 0 },
        kmh: { label: "km/h", per: 1.852, step: 1, dp: 0 },
        ms: { label: "m/s", per: 0.514444, step: 0.5, dp: 1 },
      };
      let unit = UNITS.kn;
      const show = (kn) => (kn * unit.per).toFixed(unit.dp);
      const toKn = (v) => v / unit.per;
      const tick = () => ({ kn: 10, mph: 10, "km/h": 20, "m/s": 5 })[unit.label];

      const STAR = "M0,-5 L1.47,-2.02 4.76,-1.55 2.38,0.77 2.94,4.05 0,2.5 -2.94,4.05 -2.38,0.77 -4.76,-1.55 -1.47,-2.02Z";
      function glyphs({ stars, potential }) {
        let parts = "";
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const cx = 6 + i * 14;
          if (i < stars) parts += `<path class="wf-star-glyphs__solid" d="${STAR}" transform="translate(${cx} 6.4) scale(1.1538)"/>`;
          else if (i < potential) parts += `<path class="wf-star-glyphs__faded" d="${STAR}" stroke-width="0.8233" transform="translate(${cx} 6.4) scale(1.1538)"/>`;
          else parts += `<circle class="wf-star-glyphs__dot" cx="${cx}" cy="6" r="0.84"/>`;
        }
        const label = `${stars} of 5 stars${potential > stars ? `, ${potential} on the wind alone` : ""}`;
        return `<svg class="wf-star-glyphs" width="68" height="12" viewBox="0 0 68 12" role="img" aria-label="${label}">${parts}</svg>`;
      }

      // An axis along the bottom in the rider's unit, every `tick` of it.
      function xAxis(topKn, y) {
        let out = "";
        const topU = topKn * unit.per;
        for (let v = 0; v <= topU + 1e-6; v += tick()) {
          const x = (v / topU) * 400;
          const end = x > 380;
          out += `<text class="curve__axis" x="${end ? 400 : x}" y="${y}" text-anchor="${v ? (end ? "end" : "middle") : "start"}">${v}${end ? " " + unit.label : ""}</text>`;
        }
        return out;
      }

      // Stars for each wind speed, 0 to 40 kn: theirs solid, the level they started from dashed.
      function windCurve(svg, b, base) {
        const X = (kn) => (kn / WIND_TOP) * 400, Y = (s) => 74 - (s / 5) * 64;
        const line = (bb) => { const p = []; for (let kn = 0; kn <= WIND_TOP; kn += 0.25) p.push(`${X(kn).toFixed(1)},${Y(windScore(kn, bb)).toFixed(1)}`); return p.join(" "); };
        let grid = "";
        for (let s = 1; s <= 5; s++) grid += `<line class="curve__grid" x1="0" x2="400" y1="${Y(s)}" y2="${Y(s)}"/><text class="curve__axis" x="404" y="${Y(s) + 3}">${s}★</text>`;
        const yours = line(b);
        svg.innerHTML = grid + `<polygon class="curve__under" points="0,74 ${yours} 400,74"/><polyline class="curve__base" points="${line(base)}"/><polyline class="curve__yours" points="${yours}"/>` + xAxis(WIND_TOP, 90);
        svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "Stars for each wind speed, yours against the level you started from");
      }

      // Stars taken off for each gust speed, 0 to 50 kn, hanging down from the top line.
      function gustCurve(svg, b, base) {
        const X = (kn) => (kn / GUST_TOP) * 400, Y = (s) => 8 + (s / 5) * 64;
        const line = (bb) => { const p = []; for (let kn = 0; kn <= GUST_TOP; kn += 0.25) p.push(`${X(kn).toFixed(1)},${Y(gustLoss(kn, bb)).toFixed(1)}`); return p.join(" "); };
        let grid = "";
        for (let s = 0; s <= 5; s++) grid += `<line class="curve__grid" x1="0" x2="400" y1="${Y(s)}" y2="${Y(s)}"/><text class="curve__axis" x="404" y="${Y(s) + 3}">${s ? "−" + s + "★" : "0"}</text>`;
        const yours = line(b);
        svg.innerHTML = grid + `<polygon class="curve__under" points="0,${Y(0)} ${yours} 400,${Y(0)}"/><polyline class="curve__base" points="${line(base)}"/><polyline class="curve__yours" points="${yours}"/>` + xAxis(GUST_TOP, 90);
        svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "Stars the gusts take off for each gust speed, yours against the level you started from");
      }

      // Every wind speed along the bottom and every gust up the side, shaded by the stars.
      const STEP = 2; // knots a square
      function grid(svg, b, dir) {
        const left = 30, w = 360, h = 230;
        const X = (kn) => left + (kn / WIND_TOP) * w, Y = (kn) => h - (kn / GUST_TOP) * h;
        let cells = "";
        for (let wind = 0; wind < WIND_TOP; wind += STEP) {
          for (let gust = 0; gust < GUST_TOP; gust += STEP) {
            const x = X(wind), y = Y(gust + STEP), cw = X(wind + STEP) - x, ch = Y(gust) - y;
            if (gust + STEP <= wind) { cells += `<rect class="grid__none" x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${cw}" height="${ch}"/>`; continue; }
            const r = rate(wind + STEP / 2, Math.max(gust + STEP / 2, wind + STEP / 2), b, dir);
            cells += `<rect class="grid__cell" x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${cw + 0.3}" height="${ch + 0.3}" opacity="${[0, 0.08, 0.25, 0.45, 0.65, 0.85][r.stars]}"/>`;
          }
        }
        let axes = "";
        const topW = WIND_TOP * unit.per, topG = GUST_TOP * unit.per;
        for (let v = 0; v <= topW + 1e-6; v += tick()) axes += `<text class="curve__axis" x="${left + (v / topW) * w}" y="${h + 14}" text-anchor="middle">${v}</text>`;
        for (let v = tick(); v <= topG + 1e-6; v += tick()) axes += `<text class="curve__axis" x="${left - 4}" y="${h - (v / topG) * h + 3}" text-anchor="end">${v}</text>`;
        axes += `<text class="curve__axis" x="${left + w}" y="${h + 28}" text-anchor="end">wind speed, ${unit.label} →</text>`;
        axes += `<text class="curve__axis" x="0" y="-8" text-anchor="start">gusts, ${unit.label} ↑</text>`;
        svg.innerHTML = cells + axes + `<rect class="grid__pick" data-pick width="0" height="0"/>`;
        svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "Stars for every wind speed and gust: darker is more stars");
        svg.dataset.geom = JSON.stringify({ left, w, h });
      }

      const EXAMPLES = [[10, 16], [12, 20], [15, 22], [18, 24], [18, 27], [22, 32], [25, 38], [18, 24, "onshore"], [18, 24, "crossOff"], [18, 24, "offshore"]];

      const dialogs = [];
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-ys]").forEach((host, n) => {
        const node = document.getElementById("ys").content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
        const id = `ys-title-${n}`;
        node.querySelector("[data-title]").id = id;
        node.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", id);
        if (host.hasAttribute("data-phone")) {
          node.classList.add("ys--phone");
          node.querySelectorAll(".figs").forEach((f) => (f.style.gridTemplateColumns = "repeat(2, 1fr)"));
        }
        host.replaceWith(node);
        let start = host.dataset.start;
        let b = { ...LEVELS[start], dir: { ...LEVELS[start].dir }, ...(host.dataset.custom ? JSON.parse(host.dataset.custom) : {}) };
        const isDock = Boolean(host.dataset.custom);
        let picked = "crossOff";
        let gridPick = [18, 27];
        let showFor = "crossOn";
        node.querySelector("[data-for]").innerHTML = DIRS.map((d) => `<option value="${d.key}"${d.key === showFor ? " selected" : ""}>${d.name.toLowerCase()}</option>`).join("");

        const setRange = (k, topKn) => {
          const el = node.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`);
          el.min = 0;
          el.max = (topKn * unit.per).toFixed(unit.dp);
          el.step = unit.step;
          el.value = show(b[k]);
        };
        const readout = () => {
          const [w, g] = gridPick;
          const r = rate(w, g, b, showFor);
          const off = (r.loss ? `, gusts −${Number(r.loss.toFixed(1))}` : "") + (r.off ? `, direction ${half(r.off)}` : "");
          node.querySelector("[data-readout]").innerHTML =
            `<span>${show(w)} gusting ${show(g)} ${unit.label}</span>${glyphs(r)}<span class="readout__why">wind ${Number(r.base.toFixed(1))}★${off}</span>`;
          const { left, w: gw, h } = JSON.parse(node.querySelector("[data-grid]").dataset.geom);
          const sx = left + (Math.floor(w / STEP) * STEP / WIND_TOP) * gw, sy = h - ((Math.floor(g / STEP) + 1) * STEP / GUST_TOP) * h;
          const pick = node.querySelector("[data-pick]");
          pick.setAttribute("x", sx); pick.setAttribute("y", sy);
          pick.setAttribute("width", (STEP / WIND_TOP) * gw); pick.setAttribute("height", (STEP / GUST_TOP) * h);
        };
        const draw = () => {
          const base = LEVELS[start];
          node.querySelectorAll("[data-base-name]").forEach((el) => (el.textContent = base.name));
          node.querySelectorAll("[data-preset]").forEach((el) => el.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(el.dataset.preset === start)));
          windCurve(node.querySelector('[data-curve="wind"]'), b, base);
          gustCurve(node.querySelector('[data-curve="gust"]'), b, base);
          grid(node.querySelector("[data-grid]"), b, showFor);
          web(node.querySelector("[data-shore]"), b, picked);
          node.querySelector("[data-picked-name]").textContent = DIRS.find((d) => d.key === picked).name;
          node.querySelector("[data-picked-value]").textContent = `${half(b.dir[picked])}★`;

          WIND_KEYS.forEach((k) => setRange(k, WIND_TOP));
          GUST_KEYS.forEach((k) => setRange(k, GUST_TOP));
          [...WIND_KEYS, ...GUST_KEYS].forEach((k) => (node.querySelector(`[data-v="${k}"]`).innerHTML = `${show(b[k])}<small> ${unit.label}</small>`));
          node.querySelectorAll("[data-most]").forEach((el) => el.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(Number(el.dataset.most) === b.most)));
          node.querySelectorAll("[data-span]").forEach((el) => {
            const [from, to] = el.dataset.span.split("-");
            const top = el.dataset.scale === "gust" ? GUST_TOP : WIND_TOP;
            el.style.left = `${(b[from] / top) * 100}%`;
            el.style.width = `${((b[to] - b[from]) / top) * 100}%`;
          });
          node.querySelector("[data-forecast-head]").textContent = `Forecast, ${unit.label}`;
          node.querySelector("[data-rates]").innerHTML = EXAMPLES.map(([wind, gust, dir = "crossOn"]) => {
            const o = rate(wind, gust, base, dir), y = rate(wind, gust, b, dir);
            return `<tr><td class="${o.stars !== y.stars ? "rates__moved" : ""}">${show(wind)} gusting ${show(gust)}${dir === "crossOn" ? "" : ", " + DIR_WORD[dir]}</td><td>${glyphs(o)}</td><td>${glyphs(y)}</td></tr>`;
          }).join("");
          readout();
          if (isDock) drawDock(b);
        };

        // Handles keep their order, a knot apart: minimum < ideal from < ideal to < maximum; no effect < most off.
        const order = (keys, i, kn) => {
          if (keys[i - 1]) kn = Math.max(kn, b[keys[i - 1]] + 1);
          if (keys[i + 1]) kn = Math.min(kn, b[keys[i + 1]] - 1);
          return kn;
        };
        WIND_KEYS.forEach((k, i) => node.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`).addEventListener("input", (e) => { b[k] = clamp(order(WIND_KEYS, i, toKn(Number(e.target.value))), 2 + i, WIND_TOP - (3 - i)); draw(); }));
        GUST_KEYS.forEach((k, i) => node.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`).addEventListener("input", (e) => { b[k] = clamp(order(GUST_KEYS, i, toKn(Number(e.target.value))), 1 + i, GUST_TOP - (1 - i)); draw(); }));
        node.querySelectorAll("[data-most]").forEach((el) => el.addEventListener("click", () => { b.most = Number(el.dataset.most); draw(); }));
        node.querySelectorAll("[data-preset]").forEach((el) => el.addEventListener("click", () => { start = el.dataset.preset; b = { ...LEVELS[start], dir: { ...LEVELS[start].dir } }; draw(); }));
        const webEl = node.querySelector("[data-shore]");
        const setOff = (key, off) => {
          b.dir = { ...b.dir, [key]: clamp(Math.round(off * 2) / 2, 0, 5) };
          draw();
        };
        const at = (e) => { const pt = webEl.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = e.clientX; pt.y = e.clientY; return pt.matrixTransform(webEl.getScreenCTM().inverse()); };
        let dragging = null;
        webEl.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
          const p = at(e);
          // A dot under the finger: the picked direction's first, since it is drawn on top.
          const hits = DIRS.flatMap((d) => d.at.map((a) => { const [x, y] = polar(a, radius(b.dir[d.key])); return { key: d.key, dist: Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) }; }))
            .filter((h) => h.dist < 12)
            .sort((x, y) => (y.key === picked) - (x.key === picked) || x.dist - y.dist);
          if (hits.length) {
            picked = hits[0].key;
            dragging = picked;
            webEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            draw();
            return;
          }
          // Otherwise a slice: tapping it brings its dot to the top, and changes nothing.
          const slice = e.target.closest("[data-slice]");
          if (slice) { picked = slice.dataset.slice; draw(); }
        });
        webEl.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
          if (!dragging) return;
          const p = at(e);
          setOff(dragging, (1 - Math.min(Math.hypot(p.x, p.y), R) / R) * 5);
        });
        const stop = () => (dragging = null);
        webEl.addEventListener("pointerup", stop);
        webEl.addEventListener("pointercancel", stop);
        webEl.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          const dot = e.target.closest("[data-dot]");
          if (!dot) return;
          const step = { ArrowDown: 0.5, ArrowLeft: 0.5, ArrowUp: -0.5, ArrowRight: -0.5 }[e.key];
          if (step === undefined) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          picked = dot.dataset.dot;
          setOff(picked, b.dir[picked] + step);
          node.querySelector(`[data-dot="${picked}"][tabindex]`).focus();
        });
        node.querySelectorAll("[data-step]").forEach((el) => el.addEventListener("click", () => setOff(picked, b.dir[picked] + Number(el.dataset.step) * 0.5)));
        node.querySelector("[data-for]").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
          showFor = e.target.value;
          draw();
        });
        const gridEl = node.querySelector("[data-grid]");
        const pickAt = (e) => {
          const { left, w, h } = JSON.parse(gridEl.dataset.geom);
          const pt = gridEl.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = e.clientX; pt.y = e.clientY;
          const p = pt.matrixTransform(gridEl.getScreenCTM().inverse());
          const wind = clamp(((p.x - left) / w) * WIND_TOP, 0, WIND_TOP - 0.01), gust = clamp(((h - p.y) / h) * GUST_TOP, 0, GUST_TOP - 0.01);
          gridPick = [Math.round(wind), Math.max(Math.round(gust), Math.round(wind))];
          readout();
        };
        gridEl.addEventListener("pointermove", pickAt);
        gridEl.addEventListener("pointerdown", pickAt);
        dialogs.push(draw);
        draw();
      });

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-unit]").forEach((el) =>
        el.addEventListener("click", () => {
          unit = UNITS[el.dataset.unit];
          document.querySelectorAll("[data-unit]").forEach((u) => u.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(u === el)));
          dialogs.forEach((draw) => draw());
        }),
      );

      // A Saturday afternoon at Dollymount, rated with the custom stars in the first dialog.
      function drawDock(b) {
        const HOURS = [[11, 14, 19, "cross"], [12, 17, 23, "crossOn"], [13, 19, 24, "crossOn"], [14, 20, 25, "crossOn"], [15, 21, 28, "onshore"], [16, 22, 31, "onshore"], [17, 19, 27, "cross"], [18, 16, 22, "crossOff"]];
        document.querySelector("[data-hours]").innerHTML = HOURS.map(([h, w, g, d]) =>
          `<div class="hour"><span class="hour__ist">${h}</span>${glyphs(rate(w, g, b, d))}<span>${show(w)}g${show(g)}</span></div>`,
        ).join("");
      }
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
